74: 
75:   /* Progress is state, not an action.  If the UI is blocked on LCD I/O,
76:    * retain the newest progress value instead of filling the queue with stale
77:    * intermediate values. */
78:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PROGRESS ||
79:       event->type == VS_INPUT_COMBO_PROGRESS)
80:     {
81:       uint8_t index;
82:       uint8_t i;
83: 
84:       for (i = 0, index = g_input_events.read;
85:            i < g_input_events.count;
86:            i++, index = (index + 1) % VS_INPUT_EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE)
87:         {
88:           if (g_input_events.event[index].type == event->type &&
89:               g_input_events.event[index].key == event->key)
90:             {
91:               g_input_events.event[index] = *event;
92:               pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_input_events.lock);
93:               return;
94:             }
95:         }
96:     }
97: 
98:   if (g_input_events.count == VS_INPUT_EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE)
99:     {
100:       /* Keep action events by discarding the oldest queued event.  Progress
101:        * events are coalesced above and are safe to lose when saturated. */
102:       g_input_events.read =
103:         (g_input_events.read + 1) % VS_INPUT_EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE;
104:       g_input_events.count--;
105:     }
106: 
107:   g_input_events.event[g_input_events.write] = *event;
108:   g_input_events.write =
109:     (g_input_events.write + 1) % VS_INPUT_EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE;
110:   g_input_events.count++;
111:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_input_events.lock);
112: }
113: 
114: static bool vs_input_queue_pop(struct vs_input_event_s *event)
115: {
116:   bool available = false;
117: 
118:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_input_events.lock);
119:   if (g_input_events.count != 0)
120:     {
121:       *event = g_input_events.event[g_input_events.read];
122:       g_input_events.read =
123:         (g_input_events.read + 1) % VS_INPUT_EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE;
124:       g_input_events.count--;
125:       available = true;
126:     }
127:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_input_events.lock);
128:   return available;
129: }

131: static int vs_input_worker(int argc, FAR char *argv[])
132: {
133:   struct vs_input_event_s event;
134: 
135:   (void)argc;
136:   (void)argv;
137:   while (g_input_worker_state != NULL)
138:     {
139:       if (vs_input_poll(g_input_worker_state, &event) > 0)
140:         vs_input_queue_push(&event);
141:       usleep(CONFIG_VS_INPUT_POLL_MS * 1000);
142:     }
143: 
144:   return 0;
145: }

193: int vs_app_post_event(const struct vs_app_event_s *event)
194: {
195:   if (event == NULL || event->type < VS_APP_EVENT_PHOTO_READY ||
196:       event->type > VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_FAILED)
197:     return -EINVAL;
198: 
199:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_app_events.lock);
200:   if (g_app_events.count == VS_APP_EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE)
201:     {
202:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_app_events.lock);
203:       return -EAGAIN;
204:     }
205: 
206:   g_app_events.event[g_app_events.write] = *event;
207:   g_app_events.event[g_app_events.write].text[VS_TEXT_LONG - 1] = '\0';
208:   g_app_events.write = (g_app_events.write + 1) % VS_APP_EVENT_QUEUE_SIZE;
209:   g_app_events.count++;
210:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_app_events.lock);
211:   return 0;
212: }

251: static void *vs_network_start_worker(void *arg)
252: {
253:   struct vs_network_worker_s *worker = arg;
254:   struct vs_app_event_s event;
255:   struct vs_network_s *network = worker->network;
256:   int ret;
257: 
258:   memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));
259: #ifdef CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_VELASIGHT
260:   if (network == NULL)
261:     ret = bk7258_wifi_wait_ready();
262:   else
263:     ret = 0;
264: #else
265:   ret = 0;
266: #endif
267:   if (ret == 0 && network == NULL)
268:     ret = vs_network_open(&network);
269:   if (ret == 0)
270:     ret = vs_network_request_mode(network, worker->mode);
271: 
272:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_app_events.lock);
273:   g_network_result = network;
274:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_app_events.lock);
275:   event.type = ret < 0 ? VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_FAILED :
276:                          VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY;
277:   event.error = ret;
278:   while (vs_app_post_event(&event) == -EAGAIN)
279:     usleep(10000);
280:   free(worker);
281:   return NULL;
282: }

284: static int vs_start_network_worker(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime,
285:                                    struct vs_network_s *network,
286:                                    enum vs_net_mode_e mode)
287: {
288:   struct vs_network_worker_s *worker;
289:   pthread_t thread;
290:   pthread_attr_t attr;
291:   int ret;
292: 
293:   if (runtime->network_busy)
294:     return -EBUSY;
295: 
296:   worker = calloc(1, sizeof(*worker));
297:   if (worker == NULL)
298:     return -ENOMEM;
299: 
300:   worker->network = network;
301:   worker->mode = mode;
302:   pthread_attr_init(&attr);
303:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, 8192);
304:   ret = pthread_create(&thread, &attr, vs_network_start_worker, worker);
305:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
306:   if (ret != 0)
307:     {
308:       free(worker);
309:       return -ret;
310:     }
311: 
312:   pthread_detach(thread);
313:   runtime->network_busy = true;
314:   runtime->network_target_mode = mode;
315:   return 0;
316: }

591:         break;
592: 
593:       case VS_PAGE_VOICE_SPEAKING:
594:         snprintf(snapshot->content_title, sizeof(snapshot->content_title),
595:                  "回答建议");
596:         snprintf(snapshot->content_body, sizeof(snapshot->content_body), "%s",
597:                  runtime->result_text[0] != '\0' ? runtime->result_text :
598:                  "先听完对方\n再回应");
599:         snprintf(snapshot->status_title, sizeof(snapshot->status_title), "回答");
600:         snprintf(snapshot->status_value, sizeof(snapshot->status_value), "结果就绪");
601:         snprintf(snapshot->status_meta, sizeof(snapshot->status_meta), "播报中");
602:         vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_BACK, "取消");
603:         vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_CONFIRM, "完成");
604:         break;
605: 
606:       case VS_PAGE_PHOTO_CAPTURE:
607:         snprintf(snapshot->content_title, sizeof(snapshot->content_title),
608:                  "正在拍照");
609:         snprintf(snapshot->content_body, sizeof(snapshot->content_body),
610:                  "请看向目标");
611:         snprintf(snapshot->status_title, sizeof(snapshot->status_title), "AI");
612:         snprintf(snapshot->status_value, sizeof(snapshot->status_value), "拍摄中");
613:         snprintf(snapshot->status_meta, sizeof(snapshot->status_meta), "请稍等");
614:         vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_BACK, "取消");
615:         break;
616: 
617:       case VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING:
618:         snprintf(snapshot->content_title, sizeof(snapshot->content_title),
619:                  "切换网络");
620:         snprintf(snapshot->content_body, sizeof(snapshot->content_body),
621:                  "%s", runtime->network_busy ? "请稍等" :
622:                                                 "继续按住\n松开取消");
623:         snprintf(snapshot->status_title, sizeof(snapshot->status_title), "网络");
624:         snprintf(snapshot->status_value, sizeof(snapshot->status_value), "%s",
625:                  runtime->network_busy ? "切换中" :
626:                   runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_STA ? "切换热点" :
627:                                                         "连接网络");
628:         snprintf(snapshot->status_meta, sizeof(snapshot->status_meta), "%s",
629:                  runtime->network_busy ? "切换中" : "按住中");
630:         snapshot->progress_kind = runtime->network_busy ? VS_PROGRESS_WAIT :
631:                                                           VS_PROGRESS_HOLD;
632:         break;
633: 
634:       case VS_PAGE_SOFTAP:
635:         snprintf(snapshot->content_title, sizeof(snapshot->content_title),
636:                  "设备热点");
637:         snprintf(snapshot->content_body, sizeof(snapshot->content_body),
638:                  "密码: %s\n网页: %s", runtime->network.password,
639:                  runtime->network.address);
640:         snprintf(snapshot->status_title, sizeof(snapshot->status_title), "热点");
641:         snprintf(snapshot->status_value, sizeof(snapshot->status_value), "%s",
642:                  runtime->network.ssid);
643:         snprintf(snapshot->status_meta, sizeof(snapshot->status_meta), "待连接");
644:         vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_BACK, "按住返回");
645:         break;
646: 
647:       case VS_PAGE_ERROR:
648:       default:
649:         snprintf(snapshot->content_title, sizeof(snapshot->content_title), "出了问题");
650:          snprintf(snapshot->content_body, sizeof(snapshot->content_body),
651:                   "%.80s\n%s", runtime->error_reason,
652:                   runtime->error_retryable ? "短按重试或返回" : "短按返回");
653:         snprintf(snapshot->status_title, sizeof(snapshot->status_title), "错误");
654:         snprintf(snapshot->status_value, sizeof(snapshot->status_value), "未完成");
655:         snprintf(snapshot->status_meta, sizeof(snapshot->status_meta), "请处理");
656:         vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_BACK, "返回");
657:         if (runtime->error_retryable)
658:           vs_key_set(snapshot, VS_KEY_CONFIRM, "重试");
659:         break;
660:     }
661: 
662:   if (snapshot->progress_kind == VS_PROGRESS_HOLD)
663:     snapshot->progress = runtime->progress;
664:   if (snapshot->response_active)
665:     {
666:       snapshot->softkey[runtime->response_key].visible = true;
667:       snapshot->softkey[runtime->response_key].highlighted = true;
668:       snprintf(snapshot->softkey[runtime->response_key].text,
669:                sizeof(snapshot->softkey[runtime->response_key].text), "%s",
670:                runtime->response_text);
671:     }
672: }

730: static void vs_switch_network(struct vs_display_s *display,
731:                               struct vs_runtime_s *runtime,
732:                               struct vs_network_s *network)
733: {
734:   enum vs_net_mode_e mode = runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_STA ?
735:                             VS_NET_AP : VS_NET_STA;
736:   int ret;
737: 
738:   runtime->progress = 100;
739:   runtime->page = VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING;
740:   ret = vs_start_network_worker(runtime, network, mode);
741:   if (ret < 0)
742:     {
743:       runtime->error_target_mode = mode;
744:       vs_set_error(runtime, ret,
745:                    runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP ? VS_PAGE_SOFTAP :
746:                    runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
747:                                             VS_PAGE_HISTORY,
748:                    true);
749:     }
750:   else
751:     vs_render(display, runtime);
752: }

754: static void vs_set_error(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime, int error,
755:                          enum vs_page_e return_page, bool retryable)
756: {
757:   runtime->error = error != 0 ? error : -EIO;
758:   runtime->error_return_page = return_page;
759:   runtime->error_retryable = retryable;
760:   if (runtime->network.error == runtime->error &&
761:       runtime->network.error_reason[0] != '\0')
762:     snprintf(runtime->error_reason, sizeof(runtime->error_reason), "%s",
763:              runtime->network.error_reason);
764:   else
765:     snprintf(runtime->error_reason, sizeof(runtime->error_reason), "%s (%d)",
766:              vs_errno_reason(runtime->error), runtime->error);
767:   runtime->page = VS_PAGE_ERROR;
768: }

770: static void vs_handle_app_event(struct vs_runtime_s *runtime,
771:                                 struct vs_network_s *network,
772:                                 const struct vs_app_event_s *event)
773: {
774:   if (event->type < VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY &&
775:       (event->request_id == 0 ||
776:        event->request_id != runtime->active_request_id))
777:     {
778:       return;
779:     }
780: 
781:   switch (event->type)
782:     {
783:       case VS_APP_EVENT_PHOTO_READY:
784:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_PHOTO_CAPTURE)
785:           {
786:             if (event->text[0] == '\0')
787:               {
788:                 vs_cancel_request(runtime);
789:                 vs_set_error_reason(runtime, -EBADMSG, VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK,
790:                                     false, "拍照未返回照片");
791:               }
792:             else
793:               runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING;
794:           }
795:         break;
796: 
797:       case VS_APP_EVENT_PHOTO_FAILED:
798:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_PHOTO_CAPTURE)
799:           {
800:             vs_cancel_request(runtime);
801:             vs_set_error_reason(runtime, event->error, VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK,
802:                                 false, "拍照失败");
803:           }
804:         break;
805: 
806:       case VS_APP_EVENT_VOICE_REPLY:
807:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_THINKING)
808:           {
809:             if (event->text[0] == '\0')
810:               {
811:                 vs_cancel_request(runtime);
812:                 vs_set_error_reason(runtime, -EBADMSG,
813:                                     runtime->photo_context ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
814:                                                              VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false,
815:                                     "AI未返回回答");
816:               }
817:             else
818:               {
819:                 snprintf(runtime->result_text, sizeof(runtime->result_text),
820:                          "%s", event->text);
821:                 runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_SPEAKING;
822:               }
823:           }
824:         break;
825: 
826:       case VS_APP_EVENT_VOICE_FAILED:
827:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING ||
828:             runtime->page == VS_PAGE_VOICE_THINKING)
829:           {
830:             vs_cancel_request(runtime);
831:             vs_set_error_reason(runtime, event->error,
832:                                 runtime->photo_context ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
833:                                                          VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false,
834:                                 "语音处理失败");
835:           }
836:         break;
837: 
838:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_STARTED:
839:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_STARTING)
840:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
841:         break;
842: 
843:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_START_FAILED:
844:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_STARTING)
845:           {
846:             vs_cancel_request(runtime);
847:             vs_set_error_reason(runtime, event->error,
848:                                 runtime->social_entry_return_page, false,
849:                                 "社交会话启动失败");
850:           }
851:         break;
852: 
853:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_ALERT:
854:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING ||
855:             runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT)
856:           {
857:             runtime->emotion = event->emotion;
858:             runtime->emotion_color = event->color;
859:             snprintf(runtime->alert_text, sizeof(runtime->alert_text), "%s",
860:                      event->text);
861:             runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT;
862:           }
863:         break;
864: 
865:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_ALERT_CLEARED:
866:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT ||
867:             runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED)
868:           {
869:             runtime->emotion = VS_EMOTION_NONE;
870:             runtime->emotion_color = 0;
871:             runtime->alert_text[0] = '\0';
872:             if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT)
873:               runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
874:           }
875:         break;
876: 
877:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_PAUSED:
878:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSING)
879:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED;
880:         break;
881: 
882:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_RESUMED:
883:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESUMING)
884:           runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING;
885:         break;
886: 
887:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_PAUSE_FAILED:
888:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSING ||
889:             runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESUMING)
890:           vs_set_error_reason(runtime, event->error, VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING,
891:                               false, "社交会话操作失败");
892:         break;
893: 
894:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_RESULT:
895:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_FINALIZING)
896:           {
897:             if (event->text[0] == '\0')
898:               {
899:                 vs_cancel_request(runtime);
900:                 vs_set_error_reason(runtime, -EBADMSG, VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false,
901:                                     "社交摘要为空");
902:               }
903:             else
904:               {
905:                 snprintf(runtime->result_text, sizeof(runtime->result_text),
906:                          "%s", event->text);
907:                 runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RESULT;
908:               }
909:           }
910:         break;
911: 
912:       case VS_APP_EVENT_SOCIAL_FINALIZE_FAILED:
913:         if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_FINALIZING)
914:           {
915:             vs_cancel_request(runtime);
916:             vs_set_error_reason(runtime, event->error, VS_PAGE_HISTORY, false,
917:                                 "社交记录整理失败");
918:           }
919:         break;
920: 
921:       case VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY:
922:         runtime->network_busy = false;
923:         if (network != NULL)
924:           (void)vs_network_get_status(network, &runtime->network);
925:         runtime->error = 0;
926:         runtime->error_retryable = false;
927:         runtime->page = runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP ? VS_PAGE_SOFTAP :
928:                         runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
929:                                                  VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
930:         runtime->progress = 0;
931:         break;
932: 
933:       case VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_FAILED:
934:         runtime->network_busy = false;
935:         if (network != NULL)
936:           (void)vs_network_get_status(network, &runtime->network);
937:         runtime->error_target_mode = runtime->network_target_mode;
938:         if (runtime->network_target_mode == VS_NET_STA)
939:           {
940:             /* Failing to join the configured Wi-Fi is an offline state, not a
941:              * product error.  Keep the photo home usable and wait for the next
942:              * explicit network attempt instead of showing an error page. */
943: 
944:             runtime->error = event->error;
945:             runtime->error_retryable = false;
946:             runtime->error_reason[0] = '\0';
947:             runtime->page = runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
948:                                                      VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
949:             printf("velasight: STA unavailable (%d), continuing offline\n",
950:                    event->error);
951:           }
952:         else
953:           {
954:             vs_set_error(runtime, event->error,
955:                          runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP ? VS_PAGE_SOFTAP :
956:                          runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK :
957:                                                   VS_PAGE_HISTORY,
958:                          network != NULL);
959:           }
960:         break;
961:     }
962: }

964: static void vs_handle_event(struct vs_display_s *display,
965:                             struct vs_runtime_s *runtime,
966:                             struct vs_network_s *network,
967:                             const struct vs_input_event_s *event)
968: {
969:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PRESS)
970:     return;
971: 
972:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_COMBO_PROGRESS &&
973:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY || runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK ||
974:        (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING && !runtime->network_busy)))
975:     {
976:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING;
977:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
978:       return;
979:     }
980: 
981:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_COMBO_CANCEL &&
982:       runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING && !runtime->network_busy)
983:     {
984:       runtime->page = runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP ? VS_PAGE_SOFTAP :
985:                       runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK : VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
986:       runtime->progress = 0;
987:       return;
988:     }
989: 
990:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PROGRESS && event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM &&
991:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY ||
992:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK ||
993:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER))
994:     {
995:       if (runtime->page != VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER)
996:         runtime->social_entry_return_page = runtime->page;
997:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER;
998:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
999:       return;
1000:     }
1001: 
1002:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PROGRESS && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK &&
1003:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING ||
1004:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSED ||
1005:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT ||
1006:        runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING))
1007:     {
1008:       if (runtime->page != VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING)
1009:         runtime->social_exit_return_page = runtime->page;
1010:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING;
1011:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
1012:       return;
1013:     }
1014: 
1015:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_PROGRESS && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK &&
1016:       (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOFTAP ||
1017:        (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING &&
1018:         runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP && !runtime->network_busy)))
1019:     {
1020:       runtime->page = VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING;
1021:       runtime->progress = event->progress;
1022:       return;
1023:     }
1024: 
1025:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_CANCEL &&
1026:       runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER)
1027:     {
1028:       runtime->page = runtime->social_entry_return_page;
1029:       runtime->progress = 0;
1030:       return;
1031:     }
1032: 
1033:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_CANCEL &&
1034:       runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_EXITING)
1035:     {
1036:       runtime->page = runtime->social_exit_return_page;
1037:       runtime->progress = 0;
1038:       return;
1039:     }
1040: 
1041:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_CANCEL &&
1042:       runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING && !runtime->network_busy)
1043:     {
1044:       runtime->page = runtime->network.mode == VS_NET_AP ? VS_PAGE_SOFTAP :
1045:                       runtime->history_blank ? VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK : VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
1046:       runtime->progress = 0;
1047:       return;
1048:     }
1049: 
1050:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_NET_TOGGLE &&
1051:       runtime->page == VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING && !runtime->network_busy &&
1052:       network != NULL)
1053:     {
1054:       vs_switch_network(display, runtime, network);
1055:       return;
1056:     }
1057: 
1058:   if (event->type == VS_INPUT_SHORT)
1059:     {
1060:       /* A short confirm first entered the hold candidate page through its
1061:        * progress events.  Restore the source page so its visible short action
1062:        * gets the response state before entering voice or photo mode. */
1063:       if (runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ENTER &&
1064:           event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
1065:         {
1066:           runtime->page = runtime->social_entry_return_page;
1067:           runtime->progress = 0;
1068:         }
1069: 
1070:       if (!(runtime->page == VS_PAGE_SOFTAP && event->key == VS_KEY_BACK))
1071:         vs_acknowledge(runtime, event->key);
1072:       switch (runtime->page)
1073:         {
1074:           case VS_PAGE_HISTORY:
1075:             if (event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
1076:               {
1077:                 runtime->photo_context = false;
1078:                 (void)vs_begin_request(runtime);
1079:                 runtime->page = VS_PAGE_VOICE_LISTENING;
1080:               }
1081:             else if (event->key == VS_KEY_NEXT)
1082:               {
1083:                 runtime->index++;
1084:                 runtime->history_blank = runtime->index >= vs_history_count();
1085:                 if (runtime->history_blank)
1086:                   {
1087:                     runtime->index = vs_history_count() - 1;
1088:                     runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK;
1089:                   }
1090:               }
1091:             else if (event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
1092:               {
1093:                 if (runtime->index == 0)
1094:                   {
1095:                     runtime->history_blank = true;
1096:                     runtime->index = vs_history_count() - 1;
1097:                     runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK;
1098:                   }
1099:                 else
1100:                   runtime->index--;
1101:               }
1102:             break;
1103: 
1104:           case VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK:
1105:             if (event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
1106:               {
1107:                 runtime->photo_context = true;
1108:                 (void)vs_begin_request(runtime);
1109:                 runtime->page = VS_PAGE_PHOTO_CAPTURE;
1110:               }
1111:             else if (event->key == VS_KEY_NEXT)
1112:               {
1113:                 runtime->history_blank = false;
1114:                 runtime->index = 0;
1115:                 runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
1116:               }
1117:             else if (event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)
1118:               {
1119:                 runtime->history_blank = false;
1120:                 runtime->index = vs_history_count() - 1;
1121:                 runtime->page = VS_PAGE_HISTORY;
1122:               }
1123:             break;
1124: 
1125:           case VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_RUNNING:
1126:           case VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_ALERT:
1127:             if (event->key == VS_KEY_CONFIRM)
1128:               {
1129:                 runtime->page = VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_PAUSING;
1130:               }
1131:             break;
1132: 
1133:           case VS_PAGE_SOCIAL_STARTING:
1134:             if (event->key == VS_KEY_BACK)

299:           ret = vp_store_save(g_server.store_path, &cred);
300:           if (ret < 0)
301:             {
302:               *saved = false;
303:               *save_status = ret;
304:               len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 500,
305:                                         "写入持久存储失败，凭据未保存。");
306:             }
307:           else
308:             {
309:               *saved = true;
310:               *save_status = 0;
311:               *generation = cred.generation;
312:               len = vp_http_saved_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response),
313:                                        cred.ssid, cred.generation,
314:                                        cred.open_network);
315:             }
316:         }
317:     }
318: 
319:   if (len > 0)
320:     {
321:       ret = vp_write_all(fd, g_response, len);
322:       if (ret < 0)
323:         {
324:           /* Keep AP mode available when the phone disconnected before it
325:            * received the result page.  The record itself was already saved.
326:            */
327:           if (*saved)
328:             {
329:               *saved = false;
330:             }
331:           *save_status = ret;
332:         }
333:     }
334: }
335: 
336: static void *vp_thread(void *arg)
337: {
338:   (void)arg;
339: 
340:   for (; ; )
341:     {
342:       struct pollfd pfd;
343:       uint32_t generation = 0;
344:       int save_status = 0;
345:       bool saved = false;
346:       bool stopping;
347:       int fd;
348:       int ret;
349: 
350:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
351:       stopping = g_server.stopping;
352:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
353:       if (stopping)
354:         {
355:           break;
356:         }
357: 
358:       pfd.fd = g_server.listenfd;
359:       pfd.events = POLLIN;
360:       pfd.revents = 0;
361: 
362:       /* Polling rather than blocking in accept(): stop() then needs no signal
363:        * and no socket shutdown trick that may or may not wake accept on a
364:        * given stack.
365:        *
366:        * This requires CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG on NuttX, which the Kconfig
367:        * depends on.  Without it TCP_BACKLOG events never fire, POLLIN on a
368:        * listening socket is unreachable, and accept() blocks with no timeout
369:        * at all -- measured on the board as a service that reported
370:        * "listening" and then answered nothing.
371:        */
372: 
373:       ret = poll(&pfd, 1, VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS);
374:       if (ret < 0)
375:         {
376:           if (errno == EINTR)
377:             {
378:               continue;
379:             }
380: 
381:           break;
382:         }
383: 
384:       if (ret == 0)
385:         {
386:           continue;
387:         }
388: 
389:       fd = accept(g_server.listenfd, NULL, NULL);
390:       if (fd < 0)
391:         {
392:           if (errno == EINTR || errno == ECONNABORTED)
393:             {
394:               continue;
395:             }
396: 
397:           break;
398:         }
399: 
400:       printf("provision_web: accepted client\n");
401:       vp_handle(fd, &saved, &save_status, &generation);
402: 
403:        /* Close before notifying.  The application may leave SoftAP from the
404:         * callback, and doing that with the response still in flight is what
405:         * makes a successful save look like a failed submit on the phone.
406:        */
407: 
408:       shutdown(fd, SHUT_RDWR);
409:       close(fd);
410: 
411:       if (saved)
412:         {
413:           pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
414:           g_server.generation = generation;
415:           pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
416:         }
417: 
418:       if (saved || save_status < 0)
419:         {
420:           if (g_server.on_saved != NULL)
421:             {
422:               g_server.on_saved(save_status, generation, g_server.cb_arg);
423:             }
424:         }
425: 
426:       if (saved && g_server.one_shot)
427:         {
428:           break;
429:         }
430: 
431:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
432:       stopping = g_server.stopping;
433:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
434:       if (stopping)
435:         {
436:           break;
437:         }
438:     }
439: 
440:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
441:   if (g_server.listenfd >= 0)
442:     {
443:       close(g_server.listenfd);
444:       g_server.listenfd = -1;
445:     }
446: 
447:   g_server.state = VP_STATE_FINISHED;
448:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
449:   return NULL;
450: }
451: 
452: /* Caller holds g_lock. */
453: 
454: static void vp_reap_locked(void)
455: {
456:   if (g_server.state == VP_STATE_FINISHED)
457:     {
458:       pthread_t thread = g_server.thread;
459: 
460:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
461:       pthread_join(thread, NULL);
462:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
463:       g_server.state = VP_STATE_IDLE;
464:     }
465: }
466: 
467: int velasight_provisioning_start(
468:     const struct velasight_prov_config_s *config)
469: {
470:   struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
471:   struct sockaddr_in addr;
472:   pthread_attr_t attr;
473:   uint16_t port;
474:   int one = 1;
475:   int fd;
476:   int ret;
477: 
478:   memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
479:   if (config != NULL)
480:     {
481:       cfg = *config;
482:     }
483: 
484:   if (cfg.store_path != NULL &&
485:       strlen(cfg.store_path) >= VP_STORE_PATH_MAX)
486:     {
487:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
488:     }
489: 
490:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
491:   vp_reap_locked();
492:   if (g_server.state != VP_STATE_IDLE)
493:     {
494:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
495:       return -EALREADY;
496:     }
497: 
498:   port = cfg.port != 0 ? cfg.port :
499:          (uint16_t)CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT;
500: 
501:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
502:   if (fd < 0)
503:     {
504:       ret = -errno;
505:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
506:       return ret;
507:     }
508: 
509:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &one, sizeof(one));
510: 
511:   memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
512:   addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
513:   addr.sin_port        = htons(port);
514:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_ANY);
515: 
516:   if (bind(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) < 0 ||
517:       listen(fd, 2) < 0)
518:     {
519:       ret = -errno;
520:       close(fd);
521:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
522:       return ret;
523:     }
524: 
525:   g_server.listenfd   = fd;
526:   g_server.stopping   = false;
527:   g_server.one_shot   = cfg.one_shot;
528:   g_server.generation = 0;
529:   g_server.on_saved   = cfg.on_saved;
530:   g_server.cb_arg     = cfg.cb_arg;
531:   snprintf(g_server.store_path, sizeof(g_server.store_path), "%s",
532:            cfg.store_path != NULL ? cfg.store_path :
533:            CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE);
534:   g_server.state = VP_STATE_RUNNING;
535: 
536:   pthread_attr_init(&attr);
537:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, VP_THREAD_STACK);
538:   ret = pthread_create(&g_server.thread, &attr, vp_thread, NULL);
539:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
540:   if (ret != 0)
541:     {
542:       close(fd);
543:       g_server.listenfd = -1;
544:       g_server.state = VP_STATE_IDLE;
545:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
546:       return -ret;
547:     }
548: 
549:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
550: 
551:   printf("provision_web: listening on 0.0.0.0:%u, store %s\n",
552:          (unsigned)port, g_server.store_path);
553:   return 0;
554: }
555: 
556: int velasight_provisioning_stop(void)
557: {
558:   pthread_t thread;
559: 
560:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
561:   vp_reap_locked();
562:   if (g_server.state != VP_STATE_RUNNING)
563:     {
564:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
565:       return -EALREADY;
566:     }
567: 
568:   g_server.stopping = true;
569:   thread = g_server.thread;
570: 
571:   /* Called from the saved callback, which runs on the listener thread: joining
572:    * ourselves would deadlock, so only ask the loop to end and let the normal
573:    * exit path close the socket.  A later stop() from the application reaps it.
574:    */
575: 
576:   if (pthread_equal(thread, pthread_self()))
577:     {
578:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
579:       return 0;
580:     }
581: 
582:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
583:   pthread_join(thread, NULL);
584: 
585:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
586:   g_server.state = VP_STATE_IDLE;
587:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
588:   return 0;
589: }
590: 
591: bool velasight_provisioning_is_running(void)
592: {
593:   bool running;
594: 
595:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
596:   running = g_server.state == VP_STATE_RUNNING;
597:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
598:   return running;
599: }
600: 
601: uint32_t velasight_provisioning_generation(void)
602: {
603:   uint32_t generation;
604: 
605:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
606:   generation = g_server.generation;
607:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
608:   return generation;
609: }
610: 
611: int velasight_provisioning_load_from(
612:     const char *path, struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *out)
613: {
614:   if (path == NULL || out == NULL)
615:     {
616:       return -EINVAL;
617:     }
618: 
619:   return vp_store_load(path, out);
620: }
621: 
622: int velasight_provisioning_load(
623:     struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *out)
624: {
625:   char path[VP_STORE_PATH_MAX];
626: 
627:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
628:   if (g_server.store_path[0] != '\0')
629:     {
630:       snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s", g_server.store_path);
631:     }
632:   else
633:     {
634:       snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s", CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE);
635:     }
636: 
637:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
638: 
639:   return velasight_provisioning_load_from(path, out);

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * app/provisioning_web/vp_form.c
3:  *

5:  ****************************************************************************/
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <string.h>
10: 
11: #include "vp_form.h"
12: 
13: /* Long enough to tell "too long" from "just fits": the largest legal value is
14:  * a 63-byte passphrase, so a 64..126 byte submit is decoded and then rejected
15:  * on length, instead of arriving truncated to something legal.
16:  */
17: 
18: #define VP_FORM_VALUE_MAX 640
19: #define VP_FORM_NAME_MAX  32
20: 
21: static int vp_hexval(char c)
22: {
23:   if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
24:     {
25:       return c - '0';
26:     }
27: 
28:   if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
29:     {
30:       return c - 'a' + 10;
31:     }
32: 
33:   if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F')
34:     {
35:       return c - 'A' + 10;
36:     }
37: 
38:   return -1;
39: }
40: 
41: int vp_url_decode(const char *src, size_t srclen, char *out, size_t outlen)
42: {
43:   size_t i = 0;
44:   size_t o = 0;
45: 
46:   if (src == NULL || out == NULL || outlen == 0)
47:     {
48:       return -EINVAL;
49:     }
50: 
51:   while (i < srclen)
52:     {
53:       unsigned char byte;
54: 
55:       if (src[i] == '%')
56:         {
57:           int hi;
58:           int lo;
59: 
60:           if (srclen - i < 3)
61:             {
62:               return -EINVAL;
63:             }
64: 
65:           hi = vp_hexval(src[i + 1]);
66:           lo = vp_hexval(src[i + 2]);
67:           if (hi < 0 || lo < 0)
68:             {
69:               return -EINVAL;
70:             }
71: 
72:           byte = (unsigned char)((hi << 4) | lo);
73:           i += 3;
74:         }
75:       else if (src[i] == '+')
76:         {
77:           byte = (unsigned char)' ';
78:           i++;
79:         }
80:       else
81:         {
82:           byte = (unsigned char)src[i];
83:           i++;
84:         }
85: 
86:       /* %00 would otherwise cut the value short and leave the rest of it
87:        * unexamined, which is how a validated string stops matching the bytes
88:        * that were actually submitted.
89:        */
90: 
91:       if (byte == 0)
92:         {
93:           return -EINVAL;
94:         }
95: 
96:       if (o + 1 >= outlen)
97:         {
98:           return -E2BIG;
99:         }
100: 
101:       out[o++] = (char)byte;
102:     }
103: 
104:   out[o] = '\0';
105:   return (int)o;
106: }
107: 
108: static size_t vp_strnlen(const char *s, size_t maxlen)
109: {
110:   size_t n = 0;
111: 
112:   while (n < maxlen && s[n] != '\0')
113:     {
114:       n++;
115:     }
116: 
117:   return n;
118: }
119: 
120: static bool vp_ssid_char_ok(char c)
121: {
122:   unsigned char u = (unsigned char)c;
123: 
124:   /* Control characters only: an SSID is arbitrary bytes on the air, and a
125:    * UTF-8 name has to survive.
126:    */
127: 
128:   return u >= 0x20 && u != 0x7f;
129: }
130: 
131: static bool vp_psk_char_ok(char c)
132: {
133:   unsigned char u = (unsigned char)c;
134: 
135:   /* A WPA2 passphrase is printable ASCII.  Anything else could not have been
136:    * typed into the router either.
137:    */
138: 
139:   return u >= 0x20 && u <= 0x7e;
140: }
141: 
142: int vp_credentials_validate(
143:     const struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
144: {
145:   size_t len;
146:   size_t i;
147:   size_t api_len;
148: 
149:   if (cred == NULL)
150:     {
151:       return -EINVAL;
152:     }
153: 
154:   api_len = vp_strnlen(cred->api_key, sizeof(cred->api_key));
155:   if (api_len > VELASIGHT_PROV_API_KEY_MAX)
156:     return -EINVAL;
157:   for (i = 0; i < api_len; i++)
158:     {
159:       if ((unsigned char)cred->api_key[i] < 0x20 ||
160:           (unsigned char)cred->api_key[i] > 0x7e)
161:         return -EINVAL;
162:     }
163: 
164:   len = vp_strnlen(cred->ssid, sizeof(cred->ssid));
165:   if (len == 0 || len > VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX)
166:     {
167:       return -EINVAL;
168:     }
169: 
170:   for (i = 0; i < len; i++)
171:     {
172:       if (!vp_ssid_char_ok(cred->ssid[i]))
173:         {
174:           return -EINVAL;
175:         }
176:     }
177: 
178:   len = vp_strnlen(cred->password, sizeof(cred->password));
179:   if (len == 0)
180:     {
181:       /* The flag and the passphrase have to tell the same story, otherwise a
182:        * caller that trusts only one of them behaves differently from a caller
183:        * that trusts the other.
184:        */
185: 
186:       return cred->open_network ? 0 : -EINVAL;
187:     }
188: 
189:   if (cred->open_network)
190:     {
191:       return -EINVAL;
192:     }
193: 
194:   if (len < VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MIN || len > VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX)
195:     {
196:       return -EINVAL;
197:     }
198: 
199:   for (i = 0; i < len; i++)
200:     {
201:       if (!vp_psk_char_ok(cred->password[i]))
202:         {
203:           return -EINVAL;
204:         }
205:     }
206: 
207:   return 0;
208: }

210: int vp_form_parse(const char *body, size_t bodylen,
211:                   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
212: {
213:   uint32_t generation;
214:   unsigned nfields = 0;
215:   bool have_ssid = false;
216:   bool have_psk = false;
217:   bool have_api_key = false;
218:   size_t pos = 0;
219: 
220:   if (body == NULL || cred == NULL)
221:     {
222:       return -EINVAL;
223:     }
224: 
225:   generation = cred->generation;
226:   memset(cred, 0, sizeof(*cred));
227:   cred->generation = generation;
228: 
229:   while (pos < bodylen)
230:     {
231:       char name[VP_FORM_NAME_MAX + 1];
232:       char value[VP_FORM_VALUE_MAX];
233:       const char *sep;
234:       const char *amp;
235:       size_t fieldlen;
236:       size_t namelen;
237:       int decoded;
238: 
239:       amp = memchr(body + pos, '&', bodylen - pos);
240:       fieldlen = amp != NULL ? (size_t)(amp - (body + pos)) : bodylen - pos;
241: 
242:       if (++nfields > VP_FORM_MAX_FIELDS)
243:         {
244:           return -E2BIG;
245:         }
246: 
247:       if (fieldlen == 0)
248:         {
249:           pos += 1;
250:           continue;
251:         }
252: 
253:       sep = memchr(body + pos, '=', fieldlen);
254:       if (sep == NULL)
255:         {
256:           /* "ssid" without a value is not an empty SSID, it is a body this
257:            * code does not understand.
258:            */
259: 
260:           return -EINVAL;
261:         }
262: 
263:       namelen = (size_t)(sep - (body + pos));
264:       decoded = vp_url_decode(body + pos, namelen, name, sizeof(name));
265:       if (decoded == -EINVAL)
266:         {
267:           return -EINVAL;
268:         }
269: 
270:       if (decoded < 0)
271:         {
272:           /* A name too long to be one of ours cannot be one of ours. */
273: 
274:           goto next;
275:         }
276: 
277:       if (strcmp(name, "ssid") != 0 && strcmp(name, "password") != 0 &&
278:           strcmp(name, "mimo_apikey") != 0)
279:         {
280:           goto next;
281:         }
282: 
283:       decoded = vp_url_decode(sep + 1, fieldlen - namelen - 1,
284:                               value, sizeof(value));
285:       if (decoded < 0)
286:         {
287:           return -EINVAL;
288:         }
289: 
290:       if (strcmp(name, "ssid") == 0)
291:         {
292:           if (have_ssid)
293:             {
294:               return -EINVAL;
295:             }
296: 
297:           have_ssid = true;
298:           if ((size_t)decoded >= sizeof(cred->ssid))
299:             {
300:               return -EINVAL;
301:             }
302: 
303:           memcpy(cred->ssid, value, (size_t)decoded + 1);
304:         }
305:       else if (strcmp(name, "password") == 0)
306:         {
307:           if (have_psk)
308:             {
309:               return -EINVAL;
310:             }
311: 
312:           have_psk = true;
313:           if ((size_t)decoded >= sizeof(cred->password))
314:             {
315:               return -EINVAL;
316:             }
317: 
318:           memcpy(cred->password, value, (size_t)decoded + 1);
319:         }
320:       else
321:         {
322:           if (have_api_key || (size_t)decoded >= sizeof(cred->api_key))
323:             return -EINVAL;
324: 
325:           have_api_key = true;
326:           memcpy(cred->api_key, value, (size_t)decoded + 1);
327:         }
328: 
329: next:
330:       pos += fieldlen;
331:       if (pos < bodylen)
332:         {
333:           pos += 1; /* the '&' */
334:         }
335:     }
336: 
337:   if (!have_ssid)
338:     {
339:       return -EINVAL;
340:     }
341: 
342:   /* A form with no password field at all is how an open network is submitted
343:    * by a client that simply left the input out.
344:    */
345: 
346:   cred->open_network = cred->password[0] == '\0';
347:   return vp_credentials_validate(cred);
348: }

30: uint32_t vp_crc32(const void *data, size_t len)
31: {
32:   const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)data;
33:   uint32_t crc = 0xffffffffu;
34:   size_t i;
35: 
36:   /* Bitwise rather than a table: 114 bytes twice per save is not worth 1KB of
37:    * flash on a part that is already at 90% of its region.
38:    */
39: 
40:   for (i = 0; i < len; i++)
41:     {
42:       unsigned bit;
43: 
44:       crc ^= p[i];
45:       for (bit = 0; bit < 8; bit++)
46:         {
47:           crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xedb88320u & (uint32_t)(-(int32_t)(crc & 1u)));
48:         }
49:     }
50: 
51:   return crc ^ 0xffffffffu;
52: }

54: static void vp_put16(uint8_t *buf, uint16_t value)
55: {
56:   buf[0] = (uint8_t)(value & 0xffu);
57:   buf[1] = (uint8_t)((value >> 8) & 0xffu);
58: }
59: 
60: static void vp_put32(uint8_t *buf, uint32_t value)
61: {
62:   buf[0] = (uint8_t)(value & 0xffu);
63:   buf[1] = (uint8_t)((value >> 8) & 0xffu);
64:   buf[2] = (uint8_t)((value >> 16) & 0xffu);
65:   buf[3] = (uint8_t)((value >> 24) & 0xffu);
66: }
67: 
68: static uint16_t vp_get16(const uint8_t *buf)
69: {
70:   return (uint16_t)((uint16_t)buf[0] | (uint16_t)((uint16_t)buf[1] << 8));
71: }
72: 
73: static uint32_t vp_get32(const uint8_t *buf)
74: {
75:   return (uint32_t)buf[0] | ((uint32_t)buf[1] << 8) |
76:          ((uint32_t)buf[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t)buf[3] << 24);
77: }

79: static size_t vp_len(const char *s, size_t maxlen)
80: {
81:   size_t n = 0;
82: 
83:   while (n < maxlen && s[n] != '\0')
84:     {
85:       n++;
86:     }
87: 
88:   return n;
89: }

91: int vp_record_encode(uint8_t *buf, size_t buflen,
92:                      const struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
93: {
94:   size_t ssid_len;
95:   size_t psk_len;
96:   size_t api_len;
97:   int ret;
98: 
99:   if (buf == NULL || cred == NULL)
100:     {
101:       return -EINVAL;
102:     }
103: 
104:   if (buflen < VP_RECORD_SIZE)
105:     {
106:       return -E2BIG;
107:     }
108: 
109:   ret = vp_credentials_validate(cred);
110:   if (ret < 0)
111:     {
112:       return ret;
113:     }
114: 
115:   ssid_len = vp_len(cred->ssid, sizeof(cred->ssid));
116:   psk_len  = vp_len(cred->password, sizeof(cred->password));
117:   api_len  = vp_len(cred->api_key, sizeof(cred->api_key));
118: 
119:   memset(buf, 0, VP_RECORD_SIZE);
120:   memcpy(buf + VP_OFF_MAGIC, VP_RECORD_MAGIC, 4);
121:   vp_put16(buf + VP_OFF_VERSION, VP_RECORD_VERSION);
122:   vp_put16(buf + VP_OFF_FLAGS,
123:            cred->open_network ? VP_RECORD_FLAG_OPEN : 0);
124:   vp_put32(buf + VP_OFF_GEN, cred->generation);
125:   buf[VP_OFF_SSID_LEN] = (uint8_t)ssid_len;
126:   buf[VP_OFF_PSK_LEN]  = (uint8_t)psk_len;
127:   memcpy(buf + VP_OFF_SSID, cred->ssid, ssid_len);
128:   memcpy(buf + VP_OFF_PSK, cred->password, psk_len);
129:   memcpy(buf + VP_OFF_API, cred->api_key, api_len);
130:   vp_put32(buf + VP_OFF_CRC, vp_crc32(buf, VP_RECORD_SIZE - 4));
131:   return VP_RECORD_SIZE;
132: }
133: 
134: static bool vp_padding_is_zero(const uint8_t *buf, size_t offset,
135:                                size_t used, size_t field)
136: {
137:   size_t i;
138: 
139:   for (i = used; i < field; i++)
140:     {
141:       if (buf[offset + i] != 0)
142:         {
143:           return false;
144:         }
145:     }
146: 
147:   return true;
148: }
149: 
150: int vp_record_decode(const uint8_t *buf, size_t len,
151:                      struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
152: {
153:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s parsed;
154:   size_t ssid_len;
155:   size_t psk_len;
156:   size_t api_len;
157:   uint16_t flags;
158: 
159:   if (buf == NULL || cred == NULL)
160:     {
161:       return -EINVAL;
162:     }
163: 
164:   /* Exactly one size is legal.  A shorter file is a truncated write and a
165:    * longer one is not this format, and neither is worth guessing about.
166:    */
167: 
168:   if (len != VP_RECORD_SIZE)
169:     {
170:       return -EBADMSG;
171:     }
172: 
173:   if (memcmp(buf + VP_OFF_MAGIC, VP_RECORD_MAGIC, 4) != 0 ||
174:       vp_get16(buf + VP_OFF_VERSION) != VP_RECORD_VERSION ||
175:       buf[VP_OFF_RESERVED] != 0)
176:     {
177:       return -EBADMSG;
178:     }
179: 
180:   if (vp_get32(buf + VP_OFF_CRC) != vp_crc32(buf, VP_RECORD_SIZE - 4))
181:     {
182:       return -EBADMSG;
183:     }
184: 
185:   flags    = vp_get16(buf + VP_OFF_FLAGS);
186:   ssid_len = buf[VP_OFF_SSID_LEN];
187:   psk_len  = buf[VP_OFF_PSK_LEN];
188:   api_len  = vp_len((const char *)(buf + VP_OFF_API),
189:                     VELASIGHT_PROV_API_KEY_MAX);
190: 
191:   if ((flags & ~(uint16_t)VP_RECORD_FLAG_OPEN) != 0)
192:     {
193:       return -EBADMSG;
194:     }
195: 
196:   if (ssid_len == 0 || ssid_len > VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX)
197:     {
198:       return -EBADMSG;
199:     }
200: 
201:   if (psk_len != 0 &&
202:       (psk_len < VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MIN || psk_len > VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX))
203:     {
204:       return -EBADMSG;
205:     }
206: 
207:   if (((flags & VP_RECORD_FLAG_OPEN) != 0) != (psk_len == 0))
208:     {
209:       return -EBADMSG;
210:     }
211: 
212:   if (!vp_padding_is_zero(buf, VP_OFF_SSID, ssid_len,
213:                           VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX) ||
214:       !vp_padding_is_zero(buf, VP_OFF_PSK, psk_len,
215:                           VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX))
216:     {
217:       return -EBADMSG;
218:     }
219: 
220:   if (api_len > VELASIGHT_PROV_API_KEY_MAX ||
221:       !vp_padding_is_zero(buf, VP_OFF_API, api_len,
222:                           VELASIGHT_PROV_API_KEY_MAX))
223:     {
224:       return -EBADMSG;
225:     }
226: 
227:   memset(&parsed, 0, sizeof(parsed));
228:   memcpy(parsed.ssid, buf + VP_OFF_SSID, ssid_len);
229:   memcpy(parsed.password, buf + VP_OFF_PSK, psk_len);
230:   memcpy(parsed.api_key, buf + VP_OFF_API, api_len);
231:   parsed.generation   = vp_get32(buf + VP_OFF_GEN);
232:   parsed.open_network = psk_len == 0;
233: 
234:   /* The record can be structurally perfect and still describe credentials the
235:    * running code would refuse, for instance after a limit changes.  Treat that
236:    * as corrupt rather than handing the caller something it cannot use.
237:    */
238: 
239:   if (vp_credentials_validate(&parsed) < 0)
240:     {
241:       return -EBADMSG;
242:     }
243: 
244:   *cred = parsed;
245:   return 0;
246: }

248: static int vp_make_parent(const char *path)
249: {
250:   char dir[VP_STORE_PATH_MAX];
251:   const char *slash;
252:   size_t len;
253: 
254:   slash = strrchr(path, '/');
255:   if (slash == NULL || slash == path)
256:     {
257:       return 0;
258:     }
259: 
260:   len = (size_t)(slash - path);
261:   if (len >= sizeof(dir))
262:     {
263:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
264:     }
265: 
266:   memcpy(dir, path, len);
267:   dir[len] = '\0';
268: 
269:   if (mkdir(dir, 0777) == 0 || errno == EEXIST)
270:     {
271:       return 0;
272:     }
273: 
274:   return -errno;
275: }
276: 
277: int vp_store_temp_path(const char *path, char *buf, size_t buflen)
278: {
279:   static const char name[] = "vpsave.tmp";
280:   const char *slash;
281:   size_t dirlen;
282: 
283:   if (path == NULL || buf == NULL)
284:     {
285:       return -EINVAL;
286:     }
287: 
288:   slash = strrchr(path, '/');
289:   dirlen = slash != NULL ? (size_t)(slash - path) + 1 : 0;
290: 
291:   if (dirlen + sizeof(name) > buflen)
292:     {
293:       return -E2BIG;
294:     }
295: 
296:   memcpy(buf, path, dirlen);
297:   memcpy(buf + dirlen, name, sizeof(name));
298:   return 0;
299: }
300: 
301: int vp_store_save(const char *path,
302:                   const struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
303: {
304:   uint8_t record[VP_RECORD_SIZE];
305:   char tmp[VP_STORE_PATH_MAX + 16];
306:   FILE *stream;
307:   int ret;
308: 
309:   if (path == NULL || cred == NULL)
310:     {
311:       return -EINVAL;
312:     }
313: 
314:   if (strlen(path) >= VP_STORE_PATH_MAX)
315:     {
316:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
317:     }
318: 
319:   ret = vp_record_encode(record, sizeof(record), cred);
320:   if (ret < 0)
321:     {
322:       return ret;
323:     }
324: 
325:   ret = vp_make_parent(path);
326:   if (ret < 0)
327:     {
328:       return ret;
329:     }
330: 
331:   ret = vp_store_temp_path(path, tmp, sizeof(tmp));
332:   if (ret < 0)
333:     {
334:       return ret;
335:     }
336: 
337:   stream = fopen(tmp, "wb");
338:   if (stream == NULL)
339:     {
340:       return -errno;
341:     }
342: 
343:   /* Write, flush, fsync, close, rename.  Without the fsync the rename can be
344:    * durable while the data behind it is not, which on a power cut leaves a
345:    * record that passes its own CRC check by accident or fails it for no
346:    * reason the next boot can explain.
347:    */
348: 
349:   if (fwrite(record, 1, sizeof(record), stream) != sizeof(record) ||
350:       fflush(stream) != 0 || fsync(fileno(stream)) != 0)
351:     {
352:       ret = errno != 0 ? -errno : -EIO;
353:       fclose(stream);
354:       unlink(tmp);
355:       return ret;
356:     }
357: 
358:   if (fclose(stream) != 0)
359:     {
360:       ret = errno != 0 ? -errno : -EIO;
361:       unlink(tmp);
362:       return ret;
363:     }
364: 
365:   if (rename(tmp, path) < 0)
366:     {
367:       ret = -errno;
368:       /* Keep a complete, fsynced scratch record.  FAT replacement unlinks an
369:        * existing destination before rename, so this may be the only valid
370:        * copy left after an interrupted replacement.  load() recovers it when
371:        * the final path is absent.
372:        */
373:       return ret;
374:     }
375: 
376:   sync();
377:   return 0;
378: }
379: 
380: int vp_store_load(const char *path,
381:                   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
382: {
383:   uint8_t record[VP_RECORD_SIZE + 1];
384:   char tmp[VP_STORE_PATH_MAX + 16];
385:   FILE *stream;
386:   size_t nread;
387:   bool recover = false;
388: 
389:   if (path == NULL || cred == NULL)
390:     {
391:       return -EINVAL;
392:     }
393: 
394:   stream = fopen(path, "rb");
395:   if (stream == NULL)
396:     {
397:       /* ENOTDIR belongs with ENOENT here: a directory component that is
398:        * missing, or is a file, means nothing was ever stored.  NuttX's FAT
399:        * reports ENOTDIR for the missing-directory case where Linux reports
400:        * ENOENT, and a device that has simply never been provisioned should
401:        * not look like a broken one.  EINVAL is deliberately left alone: on
402:        * that filesystem it means the configured path cannot be represented,
403:        * which is a misconfiguration worth seeing.
404:        */
405: 
406:       if (errno == ENOENT || errno == ENOTDIR)
407:         {
408:           if (vp_store_temp_path(path, tmp, sizeof(tmp)) < 0)
409:             {
410:               return -ENOENT;
411:             }
412: 
413:           stream = fopen(tmp, "rb");
414:           if (stream == NULL)
415:             {
416:               return errno == ENOENT || errno == ENOTDIR ? -ENOENT : -errno;
417:             }
418: 
419:           recover = true;
420:         }
421:       else
422:         {
423:           return -errno;
424:         }
425:     }
426: 
427:   nread = fread(record, 1, sizeof(record), stream);
428:   fclose(stream);
429: 
430:   if (vp_record_decode(record, nread, cred) < 0)
431:     {
432:       return -EBADMSG;
433:     }
434: 
435:   if (recover)
436:     {
437:       if (rename(tmp, path) < 0)
438:         {
439:           return -errno;
440:         }
441: 
442:       sync();
443:     }
444: 
445:   return 0;
446: }

448: uint32_t vp_store_next_generation(const char *path)
449: {
450:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
451: 
452:   if (vp_store_load(path, &cred) < 0 || cred.generation == UINT32_MAX)
453:     {
454:       return 1;
455:     }
456: 
457:   return cred.generation + 1;
458: }

201: static int provision_exchange(const char *request, char *reply,

205:   struct timeval tv;

207:   int fd;
208: 
209:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
210:   if (fd < 0)
211:     {
212:       return -errno;
213:     }
214: 
215:   tv.tv_sec  = 5;
216:   tv.tv_usec = 0;
217:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
218:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));

223:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
224: 
225:   if (connect(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) < 0)
226:     {
227:       int error = -errno;
228: 
229:       close(fd);
230:       return error;
231:     }
232: 
233:   if (write(fd, request, strlen(request)) < 0)
234:     {
235:       int error = -errno;
236: 
237:       close(fd);
238:       return error;
239:     }
240: 
241:   for (; ; )
242:     {
243:       ssize_t n = read(fd, reply + total, replylen - 1 - total);

245:       if (n <= 0)
246:         {
247:           break;
248:         }
249: 
250:       total += (size_t)n;
251:       if (total >= replylen - 1)
252:         {
253:           break;
254:         }
255:     }
256: 
257:   close(fd);
258:   reply[total] = '\0';
259:   return (int)total;

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * app/provisioning_web/include/velasight_provisioning.h
3:  *
4:  * AP-mode provisioning web entry.  The application switches the radio into
5:  * SoftAP itself, calls velasight_provisioning_start(), and gets told when a
6:  * phone has submitted credentials.  This service never touches the Wi-Fi
7:  * role: it does not associate, does not run wapi, does not start DHCPD and
8:  * does not switch back to STA.  Owning both the HTTP page and the radio would
9:  * make it impossible for the application to decide when the network may drop.
10:  *
11:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
12:  ****************************************************************************/
13: 
14: #ifndef __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_INCLUDE_VELASIGHT_PROVISIONING_H
15: #define __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_INCLUDE_VELASIGHT_PROVISIONING_H
16: 
17: #include <stdbool.h>
18: #include <stddef.h>
19: #include <stdint.h>
20: 
21: #ifdef __cplusplus
22: extern "C"
23: {
24: #endif
25: 
26: /* IEEE 802.11 SSID length, and the WPA2 passphrase range.  An empty password
27:  * means an open network, which is the only reason 0 is legal.
28:  */
29: 
30: #define VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX 32
31: #define VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MIN  8
32: #define VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX  63
33: #define VELASIGHT_PROV_API_KEY_MAX 512
34: 
35: /* Where the record lives when the caller passes no path.  On SD-NAND, so it
36:  * survives a reset; /mnt itself is pseudo-filesystem and /mnt/ram is a PSRAM
37:  * ramdisk, neither of which would.
38:  *
39:  * Every component fits 8.3 because that SD-NAND is VFAT without long-name
40:  * support (CONFIG_FAT_LFN is not set). This single file contains Wi-Fi
41:  * credentials and the MiMo API key; deprecated KVDB is not used.
42:  */
43: 
44: #ifndef CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE
45: #  define CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE "/mnt/sdnand/prov/vela.cfg"
46: #endif
47: 
48: #ifndef CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT
49: #  define CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT 80
50: #endif
51: 
52: struct velasight_prov_credentials_s
53: {
54:   char     ssid[VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX + 1];
55:   char     password[VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX + 1];
56:   char     api_key[VELASIGHT_PROV_API_KEY_MAX + 1];
57:   uint32_t generation;   /* Monotonic save counter, first save is 1 */
58:   bool     open_network; /* Password is empty */
59: };
60: 
61: /* Called after the success page has been written and the connection closed,
62:  * never before.  The application may leave SoftAP from here, but keeping the
63:  * listener alive is also valid and lets the user submit another record. Doing
64:  * radio work mid-response is what makes a phone show "submit failed" for a
65:  * save that actually happened.
66:  *
67:  * status is 0 on success or a negative errno.  Credentials are deliberately
68:  * absent -- read them with velasight_provisioning_load() so a passphrase does
69:  * not travel through every callback that only wanted the notification.
70:  */
71: 
72: typedef void (*velasight_prov_saved_cb_t)(int status, uint32_t generation,
73:                                            void *arg);
74: 
75: struct velasight_prov_config_s
76: {
77:   uint16_t                  port;       /* 0 selects the built-in default */
78:   bool                      one_shot;   /* Stop after one accepted submit */
79:   const char               *store_path; /* NULL selects the built-in path */
80:   velasight_prov_saved_cb_t on_saved;   /* May be NULL */
81:   void                     *cb_arg;
82: };
83: 
84: /****************************************************************************
85:  * Name: velasight_provisioning_start
86:  *
87:  * Description:
88:  *   Bind the HTTP port and start the listener thread.  Returns 0, -EALREADY
89:  *   if it is already running, or a negative errno.  A NULL config means all
90:  *   defaults.  The config is copied, so the caller may free it.
91:  *
92:  ****************************************************************************/
93: 
94: int velasight_provisioning_start(
95:     const struct velasight_prov_config_s *config);
96: 
97: /****************************************************************************
98:  * Name: velasight_provisioning_stop
99:  *
100:  * Description:
101:  *   Close the listener and join the thread.  Returns 0, or -EALREADY when
102:  *   nothing was running.  Safe to call from the saved callback.
103:  *
104:  ****************************************************************************/
105: 
106: int velasight_provisioning_stop(void);
107: 
108: bool velasight_provisioning_is_running(void);
109: 
110: /* Saves observed in this process; 0 before the first one.  Persisted saves
111:  * from earlier boots are counted by the generation inside the record.
112:  */
113: 
114: uint32_t velasight_provisioning_generation(void);
115: 
116: /****************************************************************************
117:  * Name: velasight_provisioning_load
118:  *
119:  * Description:
120:  *   Read the stored credentials.  Returns 0, -ENOENT when nothing has been
121:  *   provisioned, -EBADMSG when the record is corrupt, or a negative errno.
122:  *
123:  ****************************************************************************/
124: 
125: int velasight_provisioning_load(
126:     struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *out);
127: 
128: int velasight_provisioning_load_from(
129:     const char *path, struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *out);
130: 
131: #ifdef __cplusplus
132: }
133: #endif
134: 
135: #endif /* __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_INCLUDE_VELASIGHT_PROVISIONING_H */

<content>
1: # AP 模式简易配网 Web
2: 
3: 板子进入 SoftAP 后调用一个入口，手机连上热点打开网页填 SSID 和密码，凭据原子写入
4: SD-NAND，应用通过回调知道「第 N 次保存成功」。
5: 
6: **本服务不切换 Wi-Fi 模式。** 不调用 `wapi`、不 `ifup/ifdown`、不关联、不启停 DHCPD。
7: 进 SoftAP 和切回 STA 全部由应用或人工完成——只有应用知道什么时候可以让网络断开。
8: 
9: ## 应用侧用法
10: 
11: ```c
12: #include "velasight_provisioning.h"
13: 
14: static void on_saved(int status, uint32_t generation, void *arg)
15: {
16:   if (status < 0)
17:     {
18:       /* 写盘失败，凭据没存下来 */
19:       return;
20:     }
21: 
22:   /* 页面已经发完、连接已经关闭。可以继续保持 SoftAP，也可以按产品
23:    * 状态在这里请求切回 STA。 */
24:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
25: 
26:   if (velasight_provisioning_load(&cred) == 0)
27:     {
28:       /* cred.ssid / cred.password / cred.open_network */
29:       /* 这里不必停止服务；用户可以返回表单继续提交。 */
30:     }
31: }
32: 
33: struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg =
34: {
35:   .port       = 0,          /* 0 → 80 */
36:    .one_shot   = false,      /* false = 保存后继续提供配网页面 */
37:   .store_path = NULL,       /* NULL → CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE */
38:   .on_saved   = on_saved,
39:   .cb_arg     = NULL,
40: };
41: 
42: velasight_provisioning_start(&cfg);
43: ```
44: 
45: | 函数 | 说明 |
46: |---|---|
47: | `velasight_provisioning_start(cfg)` | 绑定端口并启动监听线程。已在运行返回 `-EALREADY`；`cfg` 可为 NULL 表示全默认 |
48: | `velasight_provisioning_stop()` | 关闭监听并回收线程。未运行返回 `-EALREADY`。可在回调里调用 |
49: | `velasight_provisioning_is_running()` | 是否在监听 |
50: | `velasight_provisioning_generation()` | 本次运行内成功保存的次数，未保存过为 0 |
51: | `velasight_provisioning_load(out)` | 读取凭据。`-ENOENT` 未配网，`-EBADMSG` 记录损坏 |
52: | `velasight_provisioning_load_from(path, out)` | 指定路径读取 |
53: 
54: 回调只带状态码和序号，不带凭据：要凭据请显式 `load()`，这样密码不会顺着每一个只想收
55: 通知的回调链路走一遍。回调固定在**响应发完并关闭连接之后**触发——反过来会在应用切走
56: Wi-Fi 时截断响应，手机上看到的是「提交失败」而实际已经存了。
57: 
58: 监听线程是 pthread，pthread 不会比创建它的任务活得更久，所以应用要在自己的长驻任务里
59: 调 `start()`。
60: 
61: ## 手工上板验证
62: 
63: 先切 SoftAP（详见 `docs/WiFi使用说明.md`）：
64: 
65: ```sh
66: ifdown wlan0
67: ifup wlan0
68: wapi mode wlan0 3
69: wapi freq wlan0 6 1
70: wapi psk wlan0 <8-63字节密码> 3
71: wapi essid wlan0 VelaSight_AP 1
72: dhcpd_start wlan0            # 板子成为 192.168.10.1
73: ```
74: 
75: 再起配网页面：
76: 
77: ```sh
78: provision_web run            # 前台运行，Ctrl-C 停止
79: provision_web run 8080       # 换端口
80:   provision_web run --one-shot # 测试用：成功保存一次后返回
81: ```
82: 
83: 手机连上 `VelaSight_AP` 后浏览器打开 `http://192.168.10.1/`，填 SSID 和密码提交。
84: 
85: 查看已存内容（**不打印密码**）：
86: 
87: ```sh
88: provision_web show
89: # provision_web: ssid=AIPC security=wpa2 password=set generation=1
90: provision_web path
91: # /mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin
92: ```
93: 
94: 没有手机或 Wi-Fi 客户端时，用板子自己的回环把整条链路走一遍（会用测试网络覆盖已存
95: 记录，不需要进 SoftAP）：
96: 
97: ```sh
98: provision_web selftest
99: # provision_web selftest: PASS, 14 checks, 0 failures
100: reboot
101: provision_web show      # 证明记录跨重启存活
102: ```
103: 
104: 验完切回 STA，仍然按 `docs/WiFi使用说明.md`：
105: 
106: ```sh
107: dhcpd_stop
108: ifdown wlan0
109: ifup wlan0
110: wapi mode wlan0 2
111: wapi psk wlan0 <路由器密码> 3
112: wapi essid wlan0 <2.4G_SSID> 1
113: renew wlan0
114: ```
115: 
116: ## HTTP 表面
117: 
118: | 请求 | 响应 |
119: |---|---|
120: | `GET /`、`GET /index.html` | 200 表单页 |
121: | `POST /save`（`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`） | 200 成功页 / 400 校验失败 / 500 写盘失败 |
122: | 其他方法 | 405 |
123: | 其他路径 | 404 |
124: | 缺 `Content-Length` | 411 |
125: | body > 1024 字节 | 413 |
126: | 非表单 Content-Type | 415 |
127: | 请求头 > 2048 字节 | 431 |
128: | `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` | 400 |
129: 
130: 读超时 5 秒，一次只服务一个连接，每个连接答完即关闭。成功页只回显经过 HTML 转义的
131: SSID；**密码永不回显、永不进日志**。
132: 
133: 校验规则：SSID 1–32 字节且不含控制字符；密码留空表示开放网络，否则必须 8–63 字节的
134: 可打印 ASCII。表单缺 `ssid` 直接 400；`ssid` 或 `password` 重复出现按歧义拒绝，不猜。
135: 
136: ## NAND 记录
137: 
138: 默认 `/mnt/sdnand/prov/vela.cfg`，固定 626 字节，小端。该文件是配网网页的唯一配置源：
139: Wi-Fi 名称、Wi-Fi 密码和 MiMo API key 全部在此文件中读写。KVDB 是废弃功能，产品链路不使用。
140: 
141: | 偏移 | 长度 | 字段 |
142: |---|---|---|
143: | 0 | 4 | 魔数 `VSWP` |
144: | 4 | 2 | 版本，当前 1 |
145: | 6 | 2 | 标志位，bit0 = 开放网络 |
146: | 8 | 4 | generation |
147: | 12 | 1 | ssid_len，1..32 |
148: | 13 | 1 | psk_len，0 或 8..63 |
149: | 14 | 32 | SSID，补零 |
150: | 46 | 63 | 密码，补零 |
151: | 109 | 1 | 保留，必须 0 |
152: | 110 | 4 | CRC32（IEEE，覆盖 0..109） |
153: 
154: 落盘顺序是同目录的 `vpsave.tmp` → `fflush` → `fsync` → `close` → `rename` → `sync()`。
155: 若目标文件缺失但 scratch 是完整且 CRC 有效的记录，下一次读取会先将 scratch 提升为正式
156: 记录；损坏 scratch 按 `-EBADMSG` 拒绝，不会被提升。
157: 魔数、版本、两个长度、开放标志与 `psk_len` 的自洽性、补零区、保留字节和 CRC 逐项校验，
158: 任何一项不过按 `-EBADMSG` 处理，不做「尽力恢复」。
159: 
160: 只保留最新一份，提交即替换，generation 递增。凭据不镜像到 kvdb——需要的话由应用读出后
161: 自己写。
162: 
163: ## 三条平台约束（都是上板实测撞出来的）
164: 
165: 改动这三处之前先读这一节，否则会重现同样的故障：
166: 
167: 1. **`/mnt` 必须保持伪文件系统。** PSRAM ramdisk 挂在 `/mnt/ram`，不是 `/mnt`。
168:    NuttX 不允许在真实文件系统内部再挂载，`/mnt` 上挂了 littlefs 之后 SD-NAND 的
169:    `/mnt/sdnand` 会以 `-ENOTDIR` 挂载失败，持久存储静默消失。
170: 2. **`CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG=y` 是必需项。** 没有它 listening socket 上不会有
171:    `POLLIN`，`accept()` 也无超时，可停止的监听线程无法实现；症状是打印了 listening
172:    之后什么都不回。本模块 Kconfig 已 `depends on` 它，配置错误会在编译期暴露。
173: 3. **SD-NAND 是不带长名的 VFAT。** `CONFIG_FAT_LFN` 未开，路径每一段必须符合 8.3。
174:    `velasight/`、`wifi-provision.bin` 都会被 `-EINVAL` 拒绝，把 `.tmp` 追加到
175:    `wifi.bin` 得到两个点也非法——所以临时文件是固定名 `vpsave.tmp`。主机测试会逐段
176:    校验默认路径的 8.3 合规性。
177: 
178: VFAT 上 `rename` 不是单步原子：NuttX 的 VFS 先 unlink 目标，FAT 的 `rename` 拒绝覆盖。
179: 所以存在「旧记录已删、新记录未就位」的极短窗口，此时读到 `-ENOENT`；读不到截断记录，
180: 因为长度和 CRC 都会拒绝。
181: 
182: ## 安全边界
183: 
184: - **服务是明文 HTTP 且无鉴权。** 热点覆盖内的任何设备都能提交。缓解手段：SoftAP 带
185:   WPA2 密码、只在配网期间开启、配完 `stop()`，或者用 `one_shot`。
186: - **密码在 NAND 上是明文。** VFAT 没有可信的权限模型，这颗芯片也没有已确认可用的设备
187:   密钥来源，所以不假装做静态加密。可控的部分是：不写日志、不回显、只走公共 API 读取。
188:   物理拿到 SD-NAND 就能读到密码。
189: - 不要把真实密码写进仓库、提交信息或测试日志。
190: 
191: ## 测试
192: 
193: ```sh
194: cd app/provisioning_web/tests && make        # 表单/记录/HTTP/服务器
195: cd app/web_tool/host/tests   && make         # 全量回归，已包含上面这一组
196: ```
197: 
198: `vp_form.c`、`vp_store.c`、`vp_http.c` 不含任何 NuttX 头文件，`vp_server.c` 只用 POSIX
199: socket，所以连 accept 循环、回调时序和 one-shot 都能在主机上跑完，剩给真板的只有
200: 「SoftAP 和 SD-NAND 是否真的在」。

207: | `vp_form.c/.h` | URL 解码与字段校验 |

211: | `provisioning_web_main.c` | `provision_web` 命令 |

454: 
455: ### 5.8 SoftAP 和网络切换
456: 
457: 历史页返回与下一条组合长按显示网络切换进度，软键栏隐藏。SoftAP 页面右屏 `/dev/fb0` 显示热点名称，左屏 `/dev/fb1` 显示密码、网页地址和连接状态。SoftAP 返回 STA 使用返回键长按进度，非错误页提前释放保持当前模式。
458: 
459: 网络切换失败进入错误页，只能短按重试或返回，不能长按退出。
460: 
461: ## 6. 显示组件规则
462: 
463: - 长按进度环尺寸约 `152x152`，贴近圆屏外环，外缘保留 2 至 3 px。
464: - 上层、中层、下层使用固定坐标；左右屏分界线固定为 `y=32` 和 `y=108`。
465: - 中层主内容安全区为 `x=12..148`、`y=35..106`；下层固定使用两行，不能被正文占用。
466: - 主状态、索引和情绪名称使用最大可用字号；动态中文摘要使用 16 px 完整 CJK 字体。
467: - 进度环只表达真实确定进度；等待云端使用低频分段状态，不伪造百分比。
468: - 情绪颜色只做第二通道，必须同时有情绪文字或行动建议。
469: - 静态页面只在快照变化时刷新；两个 LVGL display 的刷新周期统一为 `100 ms`，所有 UI 渲染最高 `10 FPS`，窗口内多次状态变化合并为最新帧；等待动画不高于 4 Hz。
470: - `10 FPS` 是系统调度预算，不只是视觉帧率选择。双屏整帧提交会占用 AP 单核 CPU，必须主动为 Camera 拍照/JPEG、Audio 录音与播放、Wi-Fi/TLS 云端请求、Mailbox 和其他后台 worker 留出时间片；不得为追求动画流畅度恢复无限制即时刷新。
471: - 任何页面不得在两屏显示同一条核心内容。
472: - 上层标题不得超过四个汉字；左屏最下方短状态不得超过四个汉字。
473:

475: 
476: 显示层使用不可变快照，不直接读取业务状态。快照至少包含：
477: 
478: - 页面状态和内容屏文本。
479: - 状态屏模式、状态、索引和完成状态。
480: - 软键三个位置的显示文字、是否有效和响应高亮状态。
481: - 长按进度是否显示、进度值和目标动作。
482: - 情绪枚举、颜色和提醒文本。
483: - 空白页标志和照片问答阶段。
484: - 错误类别、可重试标志和短按动作。

505: 照片问答可以复用语音阶段状态，但必须由快照携带 `photo_context=true`，确保拍照和历史问答的提示语不同。

507: ## 8. 实现改造边界
508: 
509: ### 8.1 `vs_types.h`
510: 
511: 增加空白页标志、照片问答上下文、软键描述、软键响应态、长按进度类型和内容/状态双屏字段。空白页不得复用 `history_count`，应通过独立的 `history_is_blank` 表达。
512: 
513: ### 8.2 `vs_app.c`
514: 
515: - 历史索引在最后一条记录之后进入空白页，再循环到第一条记录。
516: - 空白页确认短按启动单张拍照多模态问答。
517: - 历史记录确认短按只启动当前记录问答。
518: - 社交辅助仍由历史记录页确认长按进入。
519: - 社交中确认短按暂停/继续，返回长按结束。
520: - 删除错误页长按相关分支和 `error_back_progress`。
521: - 每次短按动作设置对应软键响应态，页面切换后清除旧响应。
522: 
523: ### 8.3 `vs_display.c`
524: 
525: - 物理左侧内容屏 `/dev/fb1` 和物理右侧状态屏 `/dev/fb0` 使用独立组件树。
526: - 两棵组件树复用相同的三层坐标常量，两条分界线在 `y=32` 和 `y=108` 对齐。
527: - 进度环只在长按阶段或实际等待阶段显示；错误页强制隐藏。
528: - 下层固定为双行：左屏 `y=110..128` 显示时间或元信息、`y=130..148` 显示短状态；右屏 `y=110..128` 从左到右显示返回/下一条、`y=130..148` 显示确认相关动作。长按阶段隐藏右屏按键字段。
529: - 右屏短核心字段只允许在受约束的中层框内放大；禁止对整个中层标签做会跨越分界线的几何变换。
530: - 历史记录页和空白页使用不同内容模板。
531: - 右屏负责索引、模式、情绪和动画，左屏负责摘要、建议和操作说明。
532: 
533: ### 8.4 板级显示启动
534: 
535: - `bk7258_bringup.c` 在 VelaSight 产品配置下跳过 `bk7258_gc9d01_fb_hello_animate()` 和板级 idle 状态绘制。

1: # Wi-Fi 使用说明
2: 
3: 当前固件使用单个 `wlan0`，STA 和 SoftAP 模式互斥运行。连接开发板 UART0 后，
4: 在 CP 控制台执行 `ap_console open` 进入 NSH。
5: 
6: ## STA 模式
7: 
8: ### 存一次，之后开机自动关联（推荐）
9: 
10: ```sh
11: kvdb set wifi.ssid <2.4G_SSID>
12: kvdb set wifi.psk  <密码>          # 开放热点跳过这行
13: kvdb wifi                          # 立即关联
14: renew wlan0                        # 首次 DHCP 可能需要重试一次
15: ```
16: 
17: 凭据存在 AP 自己的 flash 分区里（`CONFIG_BK7258_KVDB_FLASH`，见
18: `使用说明-camera-display-ai_agent.md`），复位和掉电都不丢。当前 ai_agent 固件开机会
19: 自动关联并申请地址；上面的 `kvdb wifi` / `renew wlan0` 用于修改凭据后立即生效或手工救援。
20: 
21: ### 手工配网（不用 kvdb 时）
22: 
23: 进入 AP 的 NSH 后执行：
24: 
25: ```sh
26: ifup wlan0
27: wapi scan wlan0                    # 看有哪些热点；encode=8000 是开放网络
28: wapi psk wlan0 <密码> 3            # 开放热点跳过这行
29: wapi essid wlan0 <2.4G_SSID> 1
30: renew wlan0                        # 失败就再来一次，见下
31: ifconfig wlan0
32: ```
33: 
34: `renew wlan0` 用于通过 DHCP 获取热点分配的 IP、掩码和默认网关，不能省略。
35: 
36: **首次 `renew` 可能失败。** 关联完成到能收发 DHCP 之间有一段窗口，实测第一次报
37: `ERROR: netlib_obtain_ipv4addr() failed`、第二次成功。重试一次再判断。
38: 
39: ### 怎么判断真的通了
40: 
41: 看 `ifconfig wlan0` 两件事：状态是 `RUNNING`（不是 `UP` 也不是 `DOWN`），以及地址
42: 不再是 `10.0.0.2`——那个是 NuttX 的默认静态地址，没配网时就长这样。
43: 
44: ```
45: wlan0	Link encap:Ethernet HWaddr c8:47:8c:55:6b:ea at RUNNING mtu 1500
46: 	inet addr:10.192.105.127 DRaddr:10.192.104.1 Mask:255.255.254.0
47: ```
48: 
49: **不要用 `ping` 当判据。** 实测环境屏蔽 ICMP：`ping 8.8.8.8` 与
50: `ping <解析出的 IP>` 都 100% 丢包，而同一时刻 DNS 和 TLS 都是通的。用下面两个之一：
51: 
52: ```sh
53: ping -c 2 www.baidu.com    # 只看它是否打印出解析到的 IP，即 DNS 通了；丢包可以忽略
54: ```
55: 
56: 或者进 agent 跑一次真实的 HTTPS：
57: 
58: ```
59: ai_agent
60: net_test
61: ```
62: 
63: 期望输出：
64: 
65: ```
66: [vela_tls] Handshake OK: TLSv1.2 / TLS-DHE-RSA-WITH-AES-256-CBC-SHA
67: SUCCESS! HTTP Status: 200
68: ```
69: 
70: `net_status` 的 `Network connected: yes` **不能**作为判据：它只检查有没有配上地址，
71: 接口 DOWN 时也会这么说。
72: 
73: ## SoftAP 模式
74: 
75: 以下配置已在 BK7258 实板验证手机可发现并连接热点：
76: 
77: ```sh
78: ifdown wlan0
79: ifup wlan0
80: wapi mode wlan0 3
81: wapi freq wlan0 6 1
82: wapi psk wlan0 12345678 3
83: wapi essid wlan0 VelaSight_AP 1
84: dhcpd_start wlan0
85: ```
86: 
87: 其中：
88: 
89: - `3` 表示 `WAPI_MODE_MASTER` 或 WPA-CCMP。
90: - channel 固定为 6，可按现场 2.4 GHz 信道占用改为 1 至 13。
91: - WPA2 密码必须为 8 至 63 字节。
92: - `dhcpd_start` 会将板端配置为 `192.168.10.1/24`。
93: - DHCP 地址池为 `192.168.10.2` 起，最多分配 4 个租约。
94: 
95: 检查运行状态：
96: 
97: ```sh
98: ifconfig wlan0
99: wapi show wlan0
100: ```
101: 
102: 成功时 `ifconfig` 必须显示 `RUNNING`，`wapi show` 应显示
103: `WAPI_MODE_MASTER`、目标 ESSID、channel 和 AP MAC。只有 `UP` 而没有
104: `RUNNING` 表示配置已保存，但 CP 尚未成功启动 beacon。
105: 
106: 手机连接：
107: 
108: ```text
109: SSID: VelaSight_AP
110: 密码: 12345678
111: IP 设置: DHCP/自动
112: ```
113: 
114: 停止 SoftAP：
115: 
116: ```sh
117: dhcpd_stop
118: ifdown wlan0
119: ```
120: 
121: 切回 STA：
122: 
123: ```sh
124: ifup wlan0
125: wapi mode wlan0 2
126: wapi psk wlan0 <路由器密码> 3
127: wapi essid wlan0 <2.4G_SSID> 1
128: renew wlan0
129: ifconfig wlan0
130: ```
131: 
132: ## 故障排查
133: 
134: - `dhcpd_start: command not found`：当前 AP 分区不是启用 SoftAP DHCP 的最新
135:   `nsh` 镜像。`help` 的 `Builtin Apps` 必须包含 `dhcpd_start` 和 `dhcpd_stop`。
136: - 手机扫描不到热点：先检查 `ifconfig wlan0` 是否为 `RUNNING`；`wapi show`
137:   只能证明配置已保存，不能单独证明热点已经发 beacon。
138: - 重复启动 DHCP 前先执行 `dhcpd_stop`，避免旧服务仍占用 UDP 端口 67。
139: - SoftAP 模式不支持与 STA 并发；切换角色前必须停止当前角色。
140: 
141: ## 注意
142: 
143: - 不要把真实 Wi-Fi 密码提交到仓库或测试日志中。开放热点不涉及这个问题。
144: - 示例 SoftAP 密码仅用于开发测试，产品使用时必须替换。
145: - 当前的 HTTPS 是加密但未验证证书的（无 RTC/SNTP，且 `VERIFY_OPTIONAL`），详见
146:   `docs/8.16基础适配门禁验收记录.md` 第 7 节。

1: /****************************************************************************

3:  *
4:  * The listener over loopback.  This is the part that would otherwise only be
5:  * testable with a phone, a SoftAP switch and a re-flash, so it is worth the
6:  * sockets: the ordering guarantee (response first, callback second) and
7:  * one-shot mode are exactly the behaviours an application depends on.
8:  *
9:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
10:  ****************************************************************************/
11: 
12: #include <arpa/inet.h>

27: 
28: static int g_checks;
29: static int g_failures;
30: 
31: #define CHECK(cond, what)                                       \
32:   do                                                            \
33:     {                                                           \
34:       g_checks++;                                                \
35:       if (!(cond))                                              \
36:         {                                                       \
37:           g_failures++;                                         \
38:           printf("FAIL %s:%d %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, what);   \
39:         }                                                       \
40:     }                                                           \
41:   while (0)
42: 
43: static char g_dir[] = "/tmp/vp_server_testXXXXXX";
44: static char g_path[256];
45: static uint16_t g_port = 18080;
46: 
47: /* The callback records what it saw and, more importantly, whether the socket
48:  * had already been closed when it ran.
49:  */
50: 
51: static pthread_mutex_t g_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
52: static int g_cb_calls;
53: static int g_cb_status;
54: static uint32_t g_cb_generation;
55: 
56: static void on_saved(int status, uint32_t generation, void *arg)
57: {
58:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
59:   g_cb_calls++;
60:   g_cb_status = status;
61:   g_cb_generation = generation;
62:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
63: 
64:   if (arg != NULL)
65:     {
66:       *(bool *)arg = true;
67:     }
68: }
69: 
70: static int cb_calls(void)
71: {
72:   int calls;
73: 
74:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
75:   calls = g_cb_calls;
76:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
77:   return calls;
78: }
79: 
80: static void reset_callback(void)
81: {
82:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
83:   g_cb_calls = 0;
84:   g_cb_status = -1;
85:   g_cb_generation = 0;
86:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
87: }
