89: /****************************************************************************
90:  * A blunt HTTP client: send a request, read until the peer closes.  The close
91:  * matters -- the service must not leave the connection open after answering,
92:  * because the application is about to take the network away.
93:  ****************************************************************************/
94: 
95: static int http_exchange(const char *request, char *reply, size_t replylen)
96: {
97:   struct sockaddr_in addr;
98:   struct timeval tv;
99:   size_t total = 0;
100:   int fd;
101: 
102:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
103:   if (fd < 0)
104:     {
105:       return -errno;
106:     }
107: 
108:   tv.tv_sec  = 5;
109:   tv.tv_usec = 0;
110:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
111:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
112: 
113:   memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
114:   addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
115:   addr.sin_port   = htons(g_port);
116:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
117: 
118:   if (connect(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) < 0)
119:     {
120:       int error = -errno;
121:       close(fd);
122:       return error;
123:     }
124: 
125:   if (write(fd, request, strlen(request)) < 0)
126:     {
127:       int error = -errno;
128:       close(fd);
129:       return error;
130:     }
131: 
132:   for (; ; )
133:     {
134:       ssize_t n = read(fd, reply + total, replylen - 1 - total);
135: 
136:       if (n < 0)
137:         {
138:           int error = -errno;
139:           close(fd);
140:           return error;
141:         }
142: 
143:       if (n == 0)
144:         {
145:           break;
146:         }
147: 
148:       total += (size_t)n;
149:       if (total >= replylen - 1)
150:         {
151:           break;
152:         }
153:     }
154: 
155:   close(fd);
156:   reply[total] = '\0';
157:   return (int)total;
158: }
159: 
160: static int start_on_free_port(const struct velasight_prov_config_s *base)
161: {
162:   struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg = *base;
163:   int attempt;
164:   int ret = -1;
165: 
166:   for (attempt = 0; attempt < 32; attempt++)
167:     {
168:       cfg.port = g_port;
169:       ret = velasight_provisioning_start(&cfg);
170:       if (ret == 0)
171:         {
172:           return 0;
173:         }
174: 
175:       g_port = (uint16_t)(g_port + 1);
176:     }
177: 
178:   return ret;
179: }

181: static void test_lifecycle(void)

199:   CHECK(!velasight_provisioning_is_running(), "the service is idle again");

204: static void test_get_and_save(void)
205: {
206:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
207:   struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
208:   volatile bool saw_callback = false;
209:   char reply[8192];
210:   int len;
211: 
212:   memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
213:   cfg.store_path = g_path;
214:   cfg.on_saved   = on_saved;
215:   cfg.cb_arg     = (void *)&saw_callback;

217:   reset_callback();
218:   CHECK(start_on_free_port(&cfg) == 0, "the service starts for a submit");
219: 
220:   len = http_exchange("GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 192.168.10.1\r\n"
221:                       "Connection: close\r\n\r\n", reply, sizeof(reply));
222:   CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL &&
223:         strstr(reply, "name=\"ssid\"") != NULL,
224:         "GET / returns the form and the peer closes");

226: 
227:   len = http_exchange("POST /save HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 192.168.10.1\r\n"
228:                       "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n"

231:   CHECK(len > 0 && strstr(reply, "HTTP/1.1 200 OK") != NULL,

234:         "the success page names the network that was saved");

236:         "the success page does not echo the passphrase");

238:   /* The response arrived and the socket closed before the callback ran; the
239:    * flag was set by the callback, so seeing it now proves the order rather
240:    * than merely that both happened.

263:

269:                       "Content-Length: 22\r\n\r\n"

276:     }

278:   CHECK(cb_calls() == 2 && g_cb_generation == 2,
279:         "the second save produces generation 2");

7: 	bool "AP-mode provisioning web entry"
8: 	default n
9: 	depends on NET_TCP && NET_TCPBACKLOG
10: 	---help---
11: 		A minimal HTTP server that serves one form, accepts an SSID and a
12: 		passphrase, and writes them to persistent storage.  Meant to be
13: 		started by the application through
14: 		velasight_provisioning_start() once the radio is already in
15: 		SoftAP; it never changes the Wi-Fi role itself, so the
16: 		application stays in control of when the network may drop.
17: 
18: 		NET_TCPBACKLOG is required, not merely nice to have.  Without it
19: 		NuttX reports no poll event for a pending connection on a
20: 		listening socket (TCP_BACKLOG is the only source of POLLIN
21: 		there), and accept() blocks with no timeout, so a listener that
22: 		can still be stopped is impossible.  The observed symptom of
23: 		building without it is a service that reports "listening" and
24: 		then never answers a request.
25: 
26: 		The provision_web command is the manual front end for bringing
27: 		it up over the console.
28: 
29: 		The page is plain HTTP with no authentication, which is the usual
30: 		trade-off for a provisioning page on an access point.  Run it
31: 		only while provisioning.
32: 
33: if LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_PROVISION_WEB
34: 
35: config VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE
36: 	string "Provisioning record path"
37: 	default "/mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin"
38: 	---help---
39: 		Where the credential record is written.  The default is on
40: 		SD-NAND because that is the only persistent filesystem: /mnt is
41: 		pseudo-filesystem and /mnt/ram is a PSRAM ramdisk.  The parent
42: 		directory is created on demand.
43: 
44: 		Every path component must fit 8.3.  That SD-NAND is VFAT without
45: 		long-name support (CONFIG_FAT_LFN is not set), which rejects a
46: 		"velasight" directory or a "wifi-provision.bin" file with
47: 		-EINVAL rather than shortening it.
48: 
49: 		The passphrase is stored in the clear: VFAT has no permission
50: 		model to rely on and this part has no confirmed device key.  It
51: 		is never logged and never echoed back over HTTP, but physical
52: 		access to the SD-NAND reveals it.

58: 	---help---

281: 
282: - 左屏显示“正在整理记录”“正在生成建议”“正在保存记录”等用户可读阶段。
283: - 右屏显示分段等待状态；不把网络上传字节数伪装成用户进度。
284: - 成功落盘后，将新记录插入索引首位并选中，然后回到历史界面。
285: - 超时或 Schema 非法时不显示旧结果；记录标为 incomplete，并显示可重试错误码。
286: 
287: ### 5.5 SoftAP 界面
288: 
289: 目标态下物理右屏 `/dev/fb0` 显示 SSID，物理左屏 `/dev/fb1` 显示密码。SSID 和密码按固定宽度换行，
290: 默认密码可在 30 秒后遮蔽；长按确认生成随机凭据后，先持久化，再重启 SoftAP。
291: 
292: 当前 SoftAP 已通过 `vs_network_apply_ap()` 请求真实模式、地址和 DHCP；如果底层请求失败，进入
293: `VS_PAGE_ERROR`。页面在右屏显示 SSID，左屏显示密码和网页地址；配网页面保存目标 STA
294: 凭据到 `/mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin`，成功响应关闭后自动退出 AP 并切回 STA。
295: 
296: ## 6. 数据结构与本地存储
297: 
298: 社交协议沿用 `app_feature.md` 的 `social-session/v1`、`social-alert/v1`、
299: `social-finalize/v1` 和 `social-cue/v1`。闲时助手沿用 `voice-assistant/v1` 和
300: `voice-review/v1`，并增加空白页通用多模态请求 `voice-vision/v1`。设备内部使用定长字段
301: 和显式长度，禁止将网络输入直接当作 NUL 结尾字符串。
302: 
303: ### 6.1 社交会话设备侧协议抽象
304: 
305: 会议倾向图片和音频共用媒体上传入口，但云端尚未冻结实际 URL。App 不直接散落 HTTP
306: 路径，而是只依赖以下抽象操作：
307:

309: int vs_cloud_social_open(const struct vs_session_open *request);
310: int vs_cloud_social_upload(const struct vs_media_packet *packet);

317: ```
318: 
319: 设备生成 `session_id` 时使用 TRNG 随机数和设备短 ID，不只使用可能重复或尚未校时的时间戳。

297: ### 4.4 产品运行时序
298: 
299: #### 常规 STA 模式
300: 
301: ```text
302: STA_ONLINE
303:   -> wlan0 连接外部路由器
304:   -> DHCP client 获取地址
305:   -> 维持云端或其他外部网络连接
306: ```
307: 
308: #### 进入配置/文件服务模式
309: 
310: ```text
311: STA_ONLINE
312:   -> ENTER_CONFIG
313:   -> 关闭云端新请求并停止现有网络连接
314:   -> 停止 STA DHCP client
315:   -> STA disconnect/stop
316:   -> 等待 STA disconnected event
317:   -> 清理 STA 地址、路由、TX/RX 状态
318:   -> wlan0 切换到 SoftAP
319:   -> AP start success
320:   -> 设置 AP 静态 IPv4
321:   -> 启动 NuttX DHCP server
322:   -> 启动 HTTP/File Server
323:   -> AP_SERVING
324: ```
325: 
326: #### 退出配置/文件服务模式
327: 
328: ```text
329: AP_SERVING
330:   -> 停止接受新的 HTTP/File 请求
331:   -> 等待或取消在途文件操作
332:   -> 停止 DHCP server
333:   -> SoftAP stop
334:   -> 等待 AP stop event
335:   -> 清理 AP 地址、客户端计数、TX/RX 状态
336:   -> wlan0 切换到 STA
337:   -> 恢复 STA 配置和 STA MAC
338:   -> STA start/connect
339:   -> connected event
340:   -> DHCP renew
341:   -> 恢复云端或其他外部网络连接
342:   -> STA_ONLINE
343: ```
344: 
345: 切换期间不重启单片机，但以下连接状态不保留：
346: 
347: - STA 的 TCP/TLS/MQTT 等外部连接需要关闭并重建。
348: - AP 客户端在退出配置模式时会断开，需要重新关联。
349: - STA 与 AP 的 IPv4 地址、默认路由和 DHCP 状态必须分别清理和重新建立。
350: - HTTP/File Server 进程可以继续运行，但只能在 AP 地址有效且 `AP_SERVING`
351:   状态下对外提供服务。
352: 
353: ### 4.5 运行时切换兼容性要求
354: 
355: 本方案不依赖系统重启，但必须把切换设计成有界状态机：
356: 
357: - 切换前拒绝新的网络业务请求，避免应用继续创建外部 socket。
358: - 停止 active role 后等待对应 CP stop/disconnect event，不以发送 command 成功
359:   作为角色已停止的依据。
360: - 切换前关闭 DHCP client/server，清除旧 IP、网关、DNS 和默认路由。
361: - 阻止新 TX，等待 in-flight TX completion；超时对象进入 quarantine，不能直接
362:   复用共享 buffer。
363: - 清理旧 RX queue，给 RX packet 记录 role，禁止旧 STA frame 被 AP 模式消费，或
364:   反向消费。
365: - 切换 SoftAP/STA 时使用对应角色 MAC，不使用 base MAC 猜测替代。
366: - AP carrier 只有在 AP start success event 后打开，STA carrier 只有在 STA
367:   connected event 后打开。
368: - AP 模式下 HTTP/File Server 只绑定 AP 静态地址；STA 恢复后外部网络服务再绑定
369:   新的 STA 地址或由应用重新建立连接。
370: - 任意 command timeout、CP reset 或 event 丢失都进入 `ERROR`，关闭 carrier 和
371:   DHCP，禁止直接跳到下一角色。
372: 
373: 目标体验是“设备不重启、网络角色可恢复”，不是“网络业务零中断”。实际切换时间
374: 以实板为准，方案目标为 STA 到 AP 可访问约 3 至 8 秒，AP 到 STA 恢复联网约 3
375: 至 15 秒；STA 重新关联和 DHCP 可能使时间进一步增加。

## Conclusion

The most likely root cause is not the HTML parser or credential file format. It is the interaction between the successful-save callback and the asynchronous STA worker:

1. A successful web submission sets a provisioning event.
2. The main VelaSight loop consumes that event and immediately starts an automatic AP-to-STA transition.
3. The transition uses the newly submitted credentials.
4. `vs_network_apply_sta()` performs association and DHCP synchronously, without an application-level deadline or cancellation path.
5. `runtime.network_busy` is set before the worker starts and is cleared only after the worker posts `VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY` or `VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_FAILED`.
6. If association or DHCP blocks or takes an unexpectedly long time, the UI has no escape path: it remains on `VS_PAGE_NET_SWITCHING`, displaying `切换中`.

The key difference is that a successful POST changes the STA credentials and also triggers an automatic transition. A GET-only visit does not generate a save event, so the later Back long-press starts the normal transition using the existing credentials. Entering SoftAP and leaving without visiting the web also follows that simpler path.

The most relevant code is:

- [`vs_app.c:1368-1385`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L1368-L1385): successful provisioning event causes an automatic STA worker to start.
- [`vs_app.c:293-315`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L293-L315): `network_busy` is set and remains set until an app event arrives.
- [`vs_network.c:171-237`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c#L171-L237): STA association and DHCP are synchronous, with no overall timeout controlled by this code.
- [`vs_app.c:921-930,933-959`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L921-L959): only the worker completion events clear `network_busy`.
- [`vs_app.c:1015-1023,1259-1266`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L1015-L1023) and [`vs_app.c:1259-1266`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L1259-L1266): Back input cannot initiate another transition while `network_busy` is true.

## Relevant state-transition timeline

### Case 1: Enter SoftAP, do not submit, then long-press Back

1. The network worker enters AP mode through `vs_network_request_mode(..., VS_NET_AP)`.
2. [`vs_network_apply_ap()`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c#L240-L340):
   - stops and restarts `wlan0`;
   - starts SoftAP;
   - assigns `192.168.10.1`;
   - starts DHCPD;
   - starts the provisioning server.
3. UI becomes `VS_PAGE_SOFTAP`.
4. A full Back long-press reaches [`vs_handle_event()`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L1238-L1266), which calls `vs_switch_network()`.
5. The STA worker calls [`vs_network_request_mode()`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c#L393-L465).
6. It stops the provisioning server, stops DHCPD, applies the existing STA credentials, and normally posts `VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_READY`.
7. The app clears `network_busy` and leaves the switching page.

### Case 2: Enter SoftAP, visit the web with GET only, then long-press Back

The GET path only serves the page:

- [`vp_server.c:229-239`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c#L229-L239)

It does not save credentials and does not invoke the save callback. Therefore the later Back transition is effectively the same as Case 1.

This explains why merely visiting the web can appear to work.

### Case 3: Enter SoftAP and submit SSID/password

The POST path is materially different:

1. [`vp_server.c:253-315`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c#L253-L315):
   - parses the form;
   - validates SSID/password;
   - computes a generation;
   - writes the record;
   - builds the success page.
2. The response is written and the socket is closed before the callback:
   - [`vp_server.c:319-333`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c#L319-L333)
   - [`vp_server.c:400-423`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c#L400-L423)
3. `vs_network_provision_saved()` records the event:
   - [`vs_network.c:127-140`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c#L127-L140)
4. On the next application-loop pass, [`vs_network_process_events()`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c#L468-L488) consumes the event and loads the newly saved credentials.
5. The main loop then automatically starts a STA transition:
   - [`vs_app.c:1368-1385`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L1368-L1385)

That automatic transition is the important behavior. The success page says that the device is still in AP mode:

- [`vp_http.c:526-538`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_http.c#L526-L538)

However, the application begins leaving AP mode as soon as it processes the callback. The page text and the application behavior are therefore not synchronized from the user's perspective.

If the submitted SSID/password is unavailable, incorrect, incompatible, or its DHCP server does not respond, the worker may remain inside:

```text
wpa_driver_wext_associate()
netlib_obtain_ipv4addr()
```

at [`vs_network.c:205-227`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c#L205-L227).

The application retries DHCP three times, but it does not impose a deadline around the individual DHCP calls. The code only sets:

```c
ret = -ETIMEDOUT;
```

before the loop; that does not itself time-limit `netlib_obtain_ipv4addr()`. The actual blocking behavior is delegated to the network stack.

While that worker is stuck:

- `runtime.network_busy == true`;
- the UI renders `"切换中"` at [`vs_app.c:617-632`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L617-L632);
- the Back progress branch requires `!runtime.network_busy` at [`vs_app.c:1015-1023`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L1015-L1023);
- the long-press branch also requires `!runtime.network_busy` at [`vs_app.c:1259-1266`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L1259-L1266);
- `network_busy` is not cleared until the worker posts a completion event at [`vs_app.c:921-930`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L921-L930) or [`vs_app.c:933-959`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L933-L959).

Thus the Back press is not really a recovery mechanism once the saved-credential transition has started. It is intentionally ignored while the worker is busy, and there is no timeout/error event to release the state.

## Why the submitted credentials expose the problem

The submitted credentials may differ from the compiled defaults in several ways:

- the SSID may not currently be visible;
- the password may be wrong;
- the target may be 5 GHz or otherwise unsupported;
- the target may be temporarily out of range;
- the AP may be reachable but not yet ready to answer DHCP;
- the submitted network may be an open network, while the driver setup differs;
- the AP-to-STA role transition may leave stale AP network state behind.

The default credentials used in the no-submit/GET-only cases are:

- [`vs_config.c:91-98`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengjing/app/velasight/vs_config.c#L91-L98)
- configured by [`app/velasight/Kconfig:56-74`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengjing/app/velasight/Kconfig#L56-L74)

If those defaults fail, they may fail quickly enough to produce `VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_FAILED`; the newly submitted network may instead cause the driver or DHCP client to wait indefinitely or for a much longer time.

The repository's own Wi-Fi documentation confirms that DHCP timing is already known to be unreliable:

- [`docs/WiFi使用说明.md:34-37`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengjing/docs/WiFi使用说明.md#L34-L37)
- [`docs/8.16基础适配门禁验收记录.md:84-89`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengjing/docs/8.16基础适配门禁验收记录.md#L84-L89)

The documentation says the first manual DHCP attempt can fail and must be retried. The application does retry, but it does not provide a complete bounded transition state machine.

## Secondary issue: AP state is not fully cleaned before STA

The intended network plan requires:

```text
stop DHCP
stop AP
wait for AP stop/disconnect
clear old IP/routes
start STA
associate
wait for connected event
DHCP renew
```

See [`BK7258_OPENVELA_WIFI_AP_MODE_PORTING_PLAN.md:326-375`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/docs/plans/BK7258_OPENVELA_WIFI_AP_MODE_PORTING_PLAN.md#L326-L375).

The implementation is less complete:

- [`vs_network_request_mode()`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c#L405-L434) stops the provisioning service and DHCPD;
- [`vs_network_apply_sta()`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c#L180-L207) calls `ifdown`, tolerates `-ETIMEDOUT`, immediately calls `ifup`, and associates;
- there is no explicit wait for a controller/AP-stop event;
- there is no explicit clearing of the AP static address `192.168.10.1`, routes, DNS, or other STA/AP-specific L3 state.

The AP address is assigned at [`vs_network.c:292-305`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c#L292-L305), but the STA path does not explicitly undo it. The underlying `ifdown` may clear it, but the application does not verify that. This can make an already fragile AP-to-STA transition more sensitive to the timing of the web submission and AP client disconnect.

This is a secondary contributing hypothesis, not the primary explanation for the exact `"切换中"` symptom. The primary symptom still points to a worker that never posts its completion event.

## Important storage caveat from the supplied runtime log

The available runtime log contains an independent storage problem:

- [`logs/runtime/velasight-final-boot-20260818-213659.log:92-96`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengjing/logs/runtime/velasight-final-boot-20260818-213659.log#L92-L96)

It reports:

```text
SD-NAND VFAT mount failed ... error=-20
SD-NAND initialized without persistent mount
```

If this is the same firmware run used for the reproduction, a POST should not be treated as a successful provisioning event:

- `vp_store_save()` should fail when the store is unavailable;
- the server should return HTTP 500 at [`vp_server.c:298-305`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c#L298-L305);
- the callback should report a negative status at [`vp_server.c:418-423`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_server.c#L418-L423);
- the app should not treat it as a successful saved-credential event.

The Kconfig default is `/mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin` at [`app/provisioning_web/Kconfig:33-47`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/Kconfig#L33-L47), while the public-header fallback is `/mnt/sdnand/prov/vela.cfg` at [`include/velasight_provisioning.h:44-46`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/include/velasight_provisioning.h#L44-L46). In the product defconfig the Kconfig symbol is enabled, so the effective build path should be `wifi.bin`; nevertheless, `provision_web path`, the HTTP result, and `provision_web show` should be checked on the target.

This mount failure is likely a separate prerequisite failure. It can explain a POST failure, but by itself it does not explain a successful save followed by a permanently stuck STA transition.

## Minimal fix recommendation

### Required fix: make the STA transition bounded

The smallest robust fix is to ensure that every AP-to-STA worker reaches one of these terminal outcomes:

```text
NETWORK_READY
NETWORK_FAILED
```

within a finite deadline.

Specifically:

1. Put an explicit overall deadline around:
   - AP/provisioning stop;
   - `wapi_set_ifdown`;
   - association;
   - DHCP.
2. Use the underlying WAPI/DHCP APIs in a nonblocking or timeout-capable form if possible.
3. If association or DHCP fails or exceeds the deadline:
   - stop/clean the current interface;
   - set `VS_NET_ERROR` or an explicit offline STA state;
   - post `VS_APP_EVENT_NETWORK_FAILED`;
   - clear `runtime.network_busy`;
   - leave the UI on the history/offline page or a retryable error page.
4. Do not detach a worker that may still be accessing `struct vs_network_s` after the UI has abandoned it. The current worker is detached at [`vs_app.c:304-313`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L304-L313), so a timeout design must also define worker lifetime and cleanup ownership.

At minimum, add logging around these boundaries:

```text
AP provisioning stop requested
AP provisioning stop completed
AP ifdown returned
STA association started/returned
DHCP attempt started/returned
STA worker terminal result posted
```

That will immediately distinguish a provisioning-stop hang, association hang, DHCP hang, or event-queue problem.

### Recommended behavior fix: choose one save policy explicitly

The current code has contradictory behavior:

- provisioning API documentation says the service does not switch Wi-Fi and may remain in AP mode:
  - [`velasight_provisioning.h:61-65`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/include/velasight_provisioning.h#L61-L65)
- the saved HTML page says the device remains in AP mode:
  - [`vp_http.c:532-535`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/vp_http.c#L532-L535)
- but `vs_app.c` automatically starts STA immediately after processing a successful save:
  - [`vs_app.c:1382-1385`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L1382-L1385)
- the product plan expects automatic exit from AP:
  - [`VELASIGHT_MCU_APP_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md:287-294`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/docs/plans/VELASIGHT_MCU_APP_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md#L287-L294)

For the current product behavior, the least invasive option is:

- retain automatic STA switching after a successful save;
- make that transition bounded and report failures;
- change the success page text to say that the device will leave AP after the response is complete, or display an explicit “请在设备上长按返回切回 STA” policy.

If the intended UX is user-controlled exit, then remove the automatic `vs_start_network_worker(..., VS_NET_STA)` block from [`vs_app.c:1382-1385`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_app.c#L1382-L1385). Leave the saved event as a pending configuration update and let the later Back long-press initiate the transition. That aligns better with the provisioning API documentation, but it still requires a bounded STA worker.

### Also fix the role cleanup

Before STA association:

- confirm DHCPD has stopped;
- wait for AP/controller stop completion rather than treating `ifdown` command return as sufficient;
- explicitly clear the AP IPv4 address and route state;
- then bring up STA and acquire DHCP.

The current code intentionally continues after `wapi_set_ifdown()` returns `-ETIMEDOUT` at [`vs_network.c:180-185`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/velasight/vs_network.c#L180-L185). That may be acceptable as a recovery policy, but it must not be followed by an unbounded association attempt with no terminal event.

## Recommended tests

### Host-side provisioning tests

The existing provisioning tests already cover basic HTTP and persistence behavior:

- [`test_vp_server.c:204-285`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/tests/test_vp_server.c#L204-L285)
- rejection behavior at [`test_vp_server.c:287-334`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/tests/test_vp_server.c#L287-L334)
- one-shot behavior at [`test_vp_server.c:336-368`](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/app/provisioning_web/tests/test_vp_server.c#L336-L368)

Add an application/network mock layer and test:

1. AP entry succeeds and starts the provisioning listener.
2. GET only does not set `provision_event`.
3. Valid POST sets exactly one save event.
4. POST callback is delivered only after the HTTP response and socket close.
5. Save event causes exactly one STA transition.
6. A Back long-press arriving before the main loop consumes the save event does not start a second transition.
7. A Back long-press arriving while `network_busy` is true is either intentionally ignored with a visible policy, or queues a cancellation; it must not leave the app permanently blocked.
8. A failed association posts `NETWORK_FAILED`.
9. A failed or timed-out DHCP operation posts `NETWORK_FAILED`.
10. After failure, `network_busy` is false and a subsequent retry is possible.
11. A storage failure returns HTTP 500 and does not trigger an automatic STA transition.

### Target hardware tests

Run the following separate scenarios and capture UART logs with timestamps:

1. Enter SoftAP, do nothing, long-press Back.
2. Enter SoftAP, GET `/`, long-press Back.
3. Enter SoftAP, submit known-good credentials for a nearby 2.4 GHz AP.
4. Enter SoftAP, submit a deliberately nonexistent SSID.
5. Enter SoftAP, submit a known SSID with an incorrect password.
6. Enter SoftAP, submit an open-network SSID.
7. Submit, then immediately long-press Back while the save response is still visible.
8. Submit, wait 1 second, then long-press Back.
9. Repeat POST/STA/AP transitions several times.
10. Repeat with the SD-NAND mounted and unmounted.

For each run, verify:

```text
HTTP status
callback status/generation
provisioning stop result
DHCP stop result
ifdown result
association return
each DHCP attempt result
worker completion event
network_busy transition
final UI page
```

The most decisive experiment is cases 3–5. If the valid known-good network exits normally but nonexistent/wrong credentials remain on `切换中`, the root cause is confirmed as the unbounded STA association/DHCP path. If even known-good credentials hang only after a POST, then focus next on AP teardown sequencing and stale AP L3 cleanup.
